def score(client, addr, path):
    try:
        return match.check(client, addr, path)[0]
    except match.CompileError:
        return 0


def _kill(process):
    # The npm shims are .cmd files on Windows: kill the whole tree, not just cmd.exe.
    if os.name == "nt":
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/T", "/F", "/PID", str(process.pid)], capture_output=True)
    else:
        process.kill()


def _took(seconds, label, log):
    """Log a finished tool call's duration; remember slow ones so later prompts discourage them."""
    if seconds < 1:
        return
    slow = seconds >= SLOW_SECONDS
    log("  < %.1fs%s %s" % (seconds, " SLOW" if slow else "", label[:120]))
    if slow:
        SLOW_LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with SLOW_LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps({"date": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                                     "seconds": round(seconds), "command": label[:240]}) + "\n")


def _finish(key, log):
    start, label = _started.pop(key, (None, ""))
    if start is not None:
        _took(time.monotonic() - start, label, log)


def _error_message(event):
    """Error text wherever the CLI put it (opencode nests it in error.data.message); else the raw event."""
    error = event.get("error")
    for value in (event.get("message"), error if isinstance(error, str) else None,
                  (error or {}).get("message") if isinstance(error, dict) else None,
                  ((error or {}).get("data") or {}).get("message") if isinstance(error, dict) else None):
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
            return value.strip()
    return json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]


def show(line, log):
    """One stream-json event from `claude -p` as a readable console line."""
    try:
        event = json.loads(line)
    except ValueError:
        if line.startswith("timestamp="):
            if "level=ERROR" in line:
                message = line.split("error.error=", 1)[-1].strip().strip('"')
                background = bool(re.search(r'\bagent=(?:"(?:title|summary)"|title|summary)(?:\s|$)', line))
                log(("Background model error: " if background else "Agent API error: ") + message)
            return
        if line.strip():
            log(line.rstrip())
        return
    if event.get("type") == "thread.started":
        log("Agent session started.")
    elif event.get("type") in ("item.started", "item.completed"):
        item = event.get("item", {})
        kind = item.get("type")
        if kind == "command_execution":
            label = item.get("command", "").split(" -Command ", 1)[-1]
            if event["type"] == "item.started":
                log("  > " + label)
                if item.get("id"):
                    _started[item["id"]] = (time.monotonic(), label)
            else:
                log("Command finished · exit %s%s" % (item.get("exit_code"),
                    "\n" + item["aggregated_output"] if item.get("aggregated_output") else ""))
                _finish(item.get("id"), log)
        elif event["type"] == "item.completed" and kind in ("agent_message", "reasoning"):
            if item.get("text", "").strip():
                log(("Thinking · " if kind == "reasoning" else "") + item["text"].strip())
        elif event["type"] == "item.completed" and kind == "file_change":
            log("Edited: " + ", ".join(change.get("path", "") for change in item.get("changes", [])))
        elif event["type"] == "item.completed" and kind == "error":
            log("Agent error: " + _error_message(item))
    elif event.get("type") == "turn.completed":
        log("Agent turn complete.")
    elif event.get("type") in ("error", "turn.failed"):
        log("Agent error: " + _error_message(event))
    elif event.get("type") == "assistant":
        for block in event.get("message", {}).get("content", []):
            if block.get("type") == "text" and block.get("text", "").strip():
                log(block["text"].strip())
            elif block.get("type") == "tool_use":
                args = block.get("input") or {}
                detail = next((str(args[key]) for key in ("command", "file_path", "pattern", "query", "url")
                               if args.get(key)), "")
                label = "%s %s" % (block.get("name"), detail)
                log("  > " + label)
                if block.get("id"):
                    _started[block["id"]] = (time.monotonic(), label)
    elif event.get("type") == "user":  # claude: tool results
        for block in event.get("message", {}).get("content", []) or []:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_result":
                content = block.get("content", "")
                if isinstance(content, list):
                    content = "\n".join(item.get("text", "") for item in content if isinstance(item, dict))
                log("Command finished · exit %d%s" % (1 if block.get("is_error") else 0,
                    "\n" + content if content else ""))
                _finish(block.get("tool_use_id"), log)
    elif event.get("type") == "text" and isinstance(event.get("part"), dict):  # opencode
        if event["part"].get("text", "").strip():
            log(event["part"]["text"].strip())
    elif event.get("type") == "reasoning" and isinstance(event.get("part"), dict):
        if event["part"].get("text", "").strip():
            log("Thinking · " + event["part"]["text"].strip())
    elif event.get("type") == "tool_use" and isinstance(event.get("part"), dict):  # opencode
        part = event["part"]
        args = (part.get("state") or {}).get("input") or {}
        detail = next((str(args[key]) for key in ("command", "filePath", "file_path", "pattern", "query", "url")
                       if args.get(key)), "")
        label = "%s %s" % (part.get("tool"), detail)
        log("  > " + label)
        state = part.get("state") or {}
        if state.get("output") or state.get("error"):
            output = state.get("output") or state["error"]
            metadata = state.get("metadata") or {}
            exit_code = metadata.get("exit", metadata.get("exitCode", 0))
            if state.get("error") or re.search(r"(?m)^\s*\+\s*FullyQualifiedErrorId\s*:", output):
                exit_code = exit_code or 1
            log("Command finished · exit %s\n%s" % ("unknown" if exit_code is None else exit_code, output))
        times = (part.get("state") or {}).get("time") or {}
        if times.get("start") and times.get("end"):  # milliseconds
            _took((times["end"] - times["start"]) / 1000, label, log)
    elif event.get("type") == "result":
        log("Agent finished after %s turns%s." % (event.get("num_turns"), " with an error" if event.get("is_error") else ""))


RATE_LIMITED = 75
RATE = re.compile(r"rate.?limit|usage limit|too many requests|overloaded|quota (exceeded|reached)|"
                  r"insufficient (credit|quota)|status(?: code)?:? 429|you.ve hit your|upstream request failed|"
                  r"model is unavailable", re.I)
TRANSIENT = 76  # the CLI exited on its own right after such errors: worth running again
TIME_LIMIT = 77  # the per-session time limit was reached; the caller decides whether to continue
RUNTIME_FAILED = 79  # Do not retry a crashed binary with another model or goal cycle.
VARIANT_UNAVAILABLE = 78  # the model rejected the "#variant" suffix; retry with its default
VARIANT = re.compile(r"variant unavailable|unknown variant|invalid variant", re.I)
MAX_EXTENSIONS = 4  # at most this many continued sessions after a limit, so runs stay bounded
CONTINUE_PROMPT = ("Your {minutes}-minute work session ended at the time limit. Review what you did since it started "
                   "(work/agent-memory/attempts.jsonl and this campaign's recorded trials). If you made good, verified "
                   "progress and have a clear next step, reply CONTINUE on the first line and keep working for up to "
                   "{minutes} more minutes. Otherwise reply STOP on the first line, leave the best source in place, "
                   "and give the final report.\n\n")


def _progress_since(started):
    """True when a verified improvement was recorded after `started` (ISO time, UTC)."""
    path = ROOT / "work" / "agent-memory" / "attempts.jsonl"
    if not path.exists():
        return False
    from roc import research
    for row in research.journal_records(path):
        receipt = row.get("receipt") or {}
        verified = isinstance(receipt, dict) and receipt.get("verified") and receipt.get("improved")
        session_gain = (row.get("kind") == "session" and row.get("outcome") == "improved" and
                        isinstance(row.get("server_stored"), (int, float)) and
                        row["server_stored"] > row.get("before", 100))
        if str(row.get("date", "")) >= started and (verified or session_gain):
            return True
    return False


def _segment(cli, prompt, model, minutes, log, goal, switch_minutes, started):
    """One session; at its time limit, continue only with progress and only if the agent says CONTINUE."""
    code = _run_once(cli, prompt, model, minutes, log, goal, switch_minutes)
    extensions = 0
    while code == TIME_LIMIT:
        if extensions >= MAX_EXTENSIONS or not _progress_since(started):
            log("  %s reached the %d-minute limit without a verified gain; stopping." % (cli, minutes))
            return 1
        extensions += 1
        log("  %s reached the %d-minute limit with progress; asking it whether to continue (%d of %d)." %
            (cli, minutes, extensions, MAX_EXTENSIONS))
        started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        code = _run_once(cli, CONTINUE_PROMPT.format(minutes=minutes) + prompt, model, minutes, log, goal,
                         switch_minutes)
    return code


# The model itself is gone or refused: no point waiting, switch at once.
DEAD = re.compile(r"has been deprecated|model not found|unknown model|invalid model|no longer available", re.I)


def fallbacks():
    """`agent_fallbacks` setting: comma list of cli[:model] tried in order when the current model is rate limited."""
    from roc import worker
    raw = os.environ.get("ROC_AGENT_FALLBACKS") or worker.load_settings().get("agent_fallbacks") or ""
    return [tuple((item.strip().split(":", 1) + [None])[:2]) for item in str(raw).split(",") if item.strip()]


def _improvements(lines):
    """Suggestions under the run's final 'Improvements' heading; [] when the agent wrote none."""
    text = "\n".join(lines)
    head = re.search(r"^\W*improvements\W*$", text, re.I | re.M)
    if not head:
        return []
    items = [re.sub(r"^\s*(?:[-*•]|\d+[.)])\s*", "", line).strip()
             for line in text[head.end():].splitlines()]
    return [item for item in items if item and not re.search(r"no clear improvement", item, re.I)]


def run_agent(cli, prompt, model=None, minutes=120, log=print, goal=False, switch_minutes=5, auto=False):
    """Persist run evidence even when the CLI fails before writing its own lessons."""
    from roc import agent_memory
    recent = []
    suggestions = []
    code = None
    error = None
    error_type = error_traceback = None

    def output(message):
        suggestions.extend(item[:2000] for item in _improvements([str(message)]) if item[:2000] not in suggestions)
        del suggestions[3:]
        recent.append(str(message)[-1000:])
        del recent[:-12]
        log(message)

    try:
        code = _run_agent(cli, prompt, model, minutes, output, goal, switch_minutes, auto)
        return code
    except Exception as failure:
        import traceback
        error = str(failure)
        error_type = type(failure).__name__
        error_traceback = traceback.format_exc(limit=8)[-6000:]
        raise
    finally:
        agent_memory.append_record(dict(
            kind="workflow", date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), cli=cli, model=model,
            outcome="completed" if code == 0 else "failed", exit_code=code, error=error,
            error_type=error_type, error_traceback=error_traceback,
            worked_well=["CLI completed"] if code == 0 else [],
            improvements=suggestions or _improvements(recent),
            mistakes=[error or "CLI exit %s" % code] if code != 0 else [],
            avoid_next_time=["Resolve CLI failure before restarting unchanged parameters"] if code != 0 else [],
            output_tail=recent))


# Shared preamble for every agent run. Numbered and sectioned so small models keep the rules.
PREAMBLE = """\
STYLE: terse technical fragments. No greetings or narration. One line of progress only when a score changes.

TRUTH
- Submit LLM-written gains to Player Mining with the actual LLM name: roc submit CLIENT ADDR --model MODEL.
  Example for GPT-6.1 Sol: --model gpt-6.1-sol. Never label LLM work as a roc automatic mining command.
- Only a server receipt with verified=true, improved=true, score=100 is a new exact. Local 100% is a candidate.
- Never check, edit or submit a function already at 100% (score 100, matched_read_only, "already matched").
  Use matched sources only as read-only examples.
- A sym vs 0 diff may be relocation normalization. Inspect roc classify and referenced-data results:
  instruction equality alone is insufficient; referenced data and relocation coverage must also match.
  Do not invent RTTI descriptors or dismiss a data mismatch because instruction bytes match.
- Compiler builds are pinned per source with // roc-cl:, flags with // roc-flags:. Both 2008 builds and the
  common flag profiles are already brute-forced by the automatic worker: do not sweep flags by hand.

LOOP (per function)
1. Read the target asm and current best source. State the likely purpose plus one supporting fact
   (caller/callee name, string, import). Behavior is a hypothesis; never guess offsets, argument sizes or ABI.
   Inspect matched callee sources read-only before replacing placeholder types: authentic STL wrappers can
   explain shared empty comparator/allocator temporaries that unrelated empty structs do not reproduce.
2. Run check once, save the output to a log, grep it. Large function: add --context 3.
3. Classify the residue with the DIFF TABLE, pick the cheapest falsifiable change, make exactly one change.
4. Re-check. Keep the change only if the score rises; otherwise revert it and record it as rejected.
5. STOP RULE: 3 hypotheses or about 10 minutes per function without a gain, then record the missing evidence
   and move to the next target. Never replay a variant recorded as rejected.
6. On a gain, test the same fix on unresolved same-shape siblings (roc similar); solved donors are read-only.
7. PARALLEL HYPOTHESES: when several independent source variants exist (different hoist positions,
   register carriers, call forms), write each to a file under work/agent-temp/ and test them ALL AT ONCE:
   roc check-batch CLIENT ADDR v1.cpp v2.cpp v3.cpp
   It compiles every variant in parallel and ranks them; pick the winner and continue from its residue.
   This replaces the serial edit->check loop (3-8s per try) with one batched call per hypothesis set.

DIFF TABLE (residue -> first thing to try)
- Wrong immediate / allocation size / stack offset -> read the value from the target; fix the constant or type.
- Call through the IAT (call dword ptr [sym]) vs direct call -> __declspec(dllimport) on that API.
- fld/fstp dword round trips or x87 order -> /fp:fast, float literals with an f suffix.
- mov+add vs mov+lea on a nested member address -> the pointer is used once vs twice (MSVC9 register CSE).
- Same base register, different target register (mov eax,[esi] vs mov ecx,[esi]; lea eax vs lea ecx) -> HOIST the chained
  member load into a named local first (const T* t = obj->field;) BEFORE the if/call using it. This forces MSVC to chain
  eax and fixed 6 functions at 92-93% in one try. Try 2-3 hoist positions before parking.
- Only one register differs after hoisting (eax vs edx) -> split or merge a local, or name a temp; then park.
- Load/store order -> volatile to force order, or remove volatile to let stores reorder.
- Vector/color copy or x87 order -> inspect authentic constructors/operators first; POD copies and separate scalar
  stores can differ from user-defined assignment or compound expressions even with identical field layouts.
  Preserve authentic accessor return types too: a by-value BrickColor getter can change register allocation
  versus direct field comparison, even when both compile to one integer load. Avoid replacing it with volatile int.
- Data-only mismatch at 99% code-exact -> struct vs class (RTTI .?AU/.?AV), local static padding, type names.
  Check copied placeholder strings against full NUL-terminated target data first; diff excerpts can truncate names.
  Preserve target spelling, including typos. A code-exact donor's strings need not match its sibling.
- EH-state-only mismatch -> inspect member grouping and destructor lifetimes; never patch the state number.
  Two adjacent shared pointers may be one argument object rather than independently destroyed members.
  Never invent a destructor or dead store to create EH state. Inspect callee RTTI and native temporary types first;
  a 28-byte G3D::LineSegment has a real virtual destructor, unlike the trivial G3D::Capsule donor.
- Library CRT import mismatch -> inspect preprocessing defines and use an existing DLL recipe when IAT evidence proves it.
  Final /MD does not change headers already expanded without _DLL. Try the proven recipe before C++ redeclarations.
- Template stack-offset residue -> verify overload and argument order in callers before changing layout.
  Reflection getset(int, Setter) and getset(Getter, int) can differ only in copied stack slots; instantiate the proven overload.
  Count hidden aggregate-result pointers in ret N: ret 4 may be a zero-argument Boost signal, not a bool argument.
  Verify imported callee identity before trusting a near-match donor: string-copy and Boost functor copies can look alike.
- Extra push/pop of a callee-saved register -> static (internal) linkage on a helper.
- Unexpected live-in callee-saved register -> inspect callers. File-static helpers can use an optimized internal
  ABI when compiled with a caller in the same unit; reproduce proven caller context, never force registers.
- Target starts with 00 00 / cc / 90, or decodes as "add byte ptr [eax], al" -> wrong function extent, not
  code. Report it as a bounds candidate; do not tune flags.
- Field offsets / vtable slots differ -> header layout. Park unless the binary proves the layout.
  A proven subobject offset plus a genuine native type/prototype permits a typed receiver view;
  do not invent padding, fields or extra virtual methods to move it.
- Before calling [reg+offset] a field mismatch, trace reg: a load from [object] followed by an indirect call
  usually selects a vtable slot. Do not shift object fields to repair virtual dispatch.
- RTTI __RTDynamicCast: sym vs 0 alone does not prove a wrong template type. Only when referenced-data
  comparison identifies a different TargetType descriptor, substitute the binary-proven type.
- IAT-style indirect call pre-loads the pointer into a register -> declare the callee as an extern function-pointer
  variable (extern bool (__thiscall *fn)(...)), never (*(T*)addr) casts which force a register load.

SOURCES AND LIBRARIES
- Vendor files: // roc-lib: RECIPE relative/file.cpp (add // roc-lang: c for C). Find the recipe with lib-info
  and generate candidates with libs.source_for(recipe, relative_file, lang, build, flags). Example:
  // roc-lib: g3d-6.09-ijg jidctflt.c. Changed vendor bodies: register with libs.add_unit and reference the
  returned filename via roc-lib. Never a quoted #include or absolute vendor path in a candidate.
  Managed header copies use libs.add_unit and include_alias inside the managed TU. For unrelated header
  failures, extract minimal native declarations/types into that TU; never bypass private access or invent ABI.
- Do not edit roc/libs.py recipes unless a pilot already produced a server-verified gain with that change.
- Use supplied commands verbatim. Check --help once before using an option; never invent --flags/--client.

EFFICIENCY
- Use supplied context and live-server targets first; do not reread whole docs, logs or source trees.
- Batch independent reads; rg with bounded excerpts; background long commands; no idle polling.
- No duplicate submissions.
- `roc check-batch CLIENT ADDR v1.cpp v2.cpp v3.cpp` tests several hypotheses in parallel; ranked.
- `roc rtti CLIENT ADDR` shows the binary-proven RTTI types; never guess template parameters.
- `roc immediates CLIENT` lists one-constant near-misses with the target values.
- `roc failures --addr ADDR --client CLIENT` shows rejected variants before you edit.

RECORDING
- Append every trial (including zero gains) to work/agent-memory/attempts.jsonl: source hash, build, flags,
  before, after, change, rejected variants, next.
- After every submit that prints 'new best', print one line
  'SUCCESS SUMMARY: <addr> <old>%-><new>%: <what changed>; scale up: yes|no, <why>' and append
  {"kind":"success_summary","client","addresses","before","after","what_changed","scale_up":true|false,
  "scale_reason"}. scale_up = the same fix should be fanned out to siblings or the whole family.
- Before ending, append a workflow record with roc.agent_memory.append_record: kind=workflow, client,
  worked_well, mistakes, avoid_next_time (empty lists when none).

FINAL REPORT
- At most three bullets: verified gains (addr old->new, receipt), blockers, next step. Keep exact addresses,
  scores, errors and receipt paths.
- Then a heading 'Improvements' with 0-3 bullets. Each names the command and output that showed the problem,
  the fix, and the expected gain. Check `roc --help` first: do not propose a feature that already exists.
  No evidence from this run -> write 'No clear improvement identified.' Bullets reach shared memory automatically.

"""

# Compact preamble for automatic/goal campaigns (they include their own detailed instructions)
PREAMBLE_AUTO = """\
STYLE: terse technical fragments. One line progress per score change.
TRUTH: Only server verified=true, improved=true, score=100 = new exact. Local 100% = candidate.
Never work on score=100. sym vs 0 may be normalized; inspect classify and referenced data before dismissing it.
Compiler builds/flags pinned via // roc-cl:/roc-flags: - do not sweep flags.
LOOP: read asm+source -> check -> classify diff -> one falsifiable change -> re-check -> keep if score up.
PARALLEL: write several variants as files, then `roc check-batch CLIENT ADDR v1.cpp v2.cpp v3.cpp`
  compiles all at once and ranks them; continue from the winner's residue. Prefer this over serial re-checks.
TOOLS: `roc rtti CLIENT ADDR` prints the binary-proven RTTI template types a function references —
  never guess a type parameter; `roc rtti CLIENT --open` lists every open function's proven types.
  `roc immediates CLIENT` lists near-misses whose only residue is ONE wrong constant, target value included.
  `roc versions CLIENT ADDR` recompiles under every installed vendor version when a big library
  function plateaus (wrong-version source is a permanent ceiling).
  `roc failures --addr ADDR --client CLIENT` shows already-rejected variants; never replay them.
STOP: 3 hypotheses or 10 min no gain -> record evidence, move on. Test unresolved siblings (roc similar).
DIFF TABLE: wrong immediate/size/offset=fix constant; IAT call=__declspec(dllimport); x87=/fp:fast;
  register diff=HOIST chained member load into local first (const T* t = obj->field; fixes eax chain);
  load/store order=volatile; data-only=struct/class/RTTI; extent=fix bounds.
  Data-only strings=read full NUL-terminated target literals; replace donor placeholders and preserve target typos.
  Vector/color copy/order=inspect authentic constructors/operators before qualifiers or scalar rewrites.
  Preserve authentic by-value accessor returns (e.g. BrickColor); direct field/volatile-int substitutes can change registers.
  Live-in saved register=trace callers; test file-static helper with proven caller context, never force registers.
  RTTI sym vs 0 alone is not a type mismatch; require referenced-data proof of a different TargetType descriptor.
  Template stack offsets=verify overload/argument order in callers before layout changes (getset(int,Setter) vs getset(Getter,int)).
  Count hidden aggregate-result pointers in ret N; ret4 may be signal0, not bool. Verify IAT callee before trusting donor types.
  EH state=prove actual temporary type/RTTI; never invent destructor/dead stores. LineSegment has real virtual dtor, Capsule does not.
  Library CRT IAT mismatch=check _DLL preprocessing/use existing DLL recipe; final /MD cannot fix already-expanded headers.
  Proven subobject offset + native type/prototype=typed receiver view, never guessed padding/virtual methods.
  Trace the base register: [vtable+offset] before an indirect call is a virtual slot, not an object field.
  IAT call pre-loads register=use extern fn-ptr var, never (*(T*)addr) cast.
  Target inlines float math but ours IAT-calls a dllimport class method (Ogre Vector3 etc.)=
  replace with a free `static inline` helper in the unit; MSVC never inlines dllimport members (96% Ogre win).
VENDOR: // roc-lib: RECIPE file.cpp via libs.source_for. No quoted #include. No roc/libs.py edits without verified pilot.
  Managed header copies: libs.add_unit + include_alias inside managed TU. Header blocker=minimal native declarations/types, no private-access bypass.
RECORD: every trial to attempts.jsonl (hash, build, flags, before, after, change, rejected, next).
REPORT: verified receipts; blockers; next evidence. Add Improvements heading: observed problem, fix, benefit;
  no evidence -> No clear improvement identified. For each gain, state sibling scale-up yes/no and why.
"""

def _run_agent(cli, prompt, model=None, minutes=120, log=print, goal=False, switch_minutes=5, auto=False):
    """Run one agent; retry rate-limit/unavailable failures after three minutes before switching.
    A repeated failure continues with the next configured fallback within the remaining budget."""
    from roc import agent_recovery
    prompt = (agent_recovery.PREAMBLE if getattr(agent_recovery.SESSION, "value", None)
              else PREAMBLE_AUTO if auto or goal else PREAMBLE) + prompt
    deadline = time.monotonic() + minutes * 60
    if os.name == "nt":
        prompt = ("Windows shell: PowerShell. Use absolute paths; command form: " + roc_command() + " <command>. "
                  "Use Get-Content -LiteralPath PATH | Select-Object -First N; no head, sed, or Unix pipelines. "
                  "Every roc command needs its client, e.g. next 2008-06. "
                  "Use supplied candidate paths and check commands; do not search src again.\n" + prompt)
    queue = [(cli, model)] + fallbacks()
    while queue:
        current, name = queue.pop(0)
        switch_after = min(switch_minutes, max(0, (deadline - time.monotonic()) / 120)) if queue else 0
        left = (deadline - time.monotonic()) / 60
        if left <= 0:
            return 1
        started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        code = _segment(current, prompt, name, left, log, goal, switch_after, started)
        if code == VARIANT_UNAVAILABLE and name and "#" in name:
            name = name.split("#")[0]
            log("  %s does not support that reasoning variant; retrying with its default." % name)
            code = _segment(current, prompt, name, left, log, goal, switch_after, started)
        if code in (RATE_LIMITED, TRANSIENT):
            log("  %s %s is rate limited or unavailable; retrying the same model in 3 minutes." %
                (current, name or ""))
            retry_at = time.monotonic() + 180
            while True:
                remaining = min(retry_at, deadline) - time.monotonic()
                triage_remaining = agent_recovery.remaining()
                if triage_remaining is not None:
                    remaining = min(remaining, triage_remaining)
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                time.sleep(min(30, remaining))
            left = (deadline - time.monotonic()) / 60
            if left <= 0:
                log("  Agent time budget ended before the 3-minute retry; stopping.")
                return 1
            started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            code = _segment(current, prompt, name, left, log, goal, switch_after, started)
        if code not in (RATE_LIMITED, TRANSIENT):
            return code
        log("  %s %s is rate limited or unavailable; switching to %s." % (
            current, name or "", " ".join(filter(None, queue[0])) if queue else "nothing"))
    return 1


def _error_text(line):
    """The part of one CLI output line that can report a rate limit: errors only, never tool output.

    Tool results carry file contents and compiler diagnostics ("ambiguous call to overloaded
    function"), which must not look like an API limit.
    """
    try:
        event = json.loads(line)
    except ValueError:
        if line.startswith("timestamp=") and ("level=ERROR" not in line or re.search(
                r'\bagent=(?:"(?:title|summary)"|title|summary)(?:\s|$)', line)):
            return ""  # Startup chatter and auxiliary model failures do not fail the chosen model.
        return line  # plain stderr from the CLI itself
    if not isinstance(event, dict):
        return ""
    kind = event.get("type")
    if kind in ("error", "turn.failed") or (kind == "result" and event.get("is_error")):
        return line
    if kind == "assistant" and (event.get("error") or (event.get("message") or {}).get("model") == "<synthetic>"):
        return line  # claude -p reports API failures as a synthetic assistant message
    if kind == "item.completed" and (event.get("item") or {}).get("type") == "error":
        return line
    return ""


def _run_once(cli, prompt, model, minutes, log, goal, switch_minutes):
    from roc import agent_recovery
    if agent_recovery.remaining() == 0:
        agent_recovery.timeout(log)
        return 0
    if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    exe = shutil.which(cli)
    if not exe:
        raise SystemExit("%s CLI not found. Install it and sign in first (see docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md)." % cli)
    argv = command(cli, model, goal)
    argv[0] = exe
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    if os.name == "nt":
        temporary = ROOT / "work" / "agent-temp"
        temporary.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        environment.update(TEMP=str(temporary), TMP=str(temporary), TMPDIR=str(temporary))
    environment["ROC_AGENT"] = "1"  # roc submit then asks for a success summary
    environment["ROC_AGENT_MODEL"] = model or (cli + " (CLI default)")
    log("Launching %s model %s." % (cli, model or "CLI default"))
    process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                               text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", env=environment)
    triage = agent_recovery.watch(lambda: _kill(process), log)

    hit = []
    runtime_failed = False
    startup_expired = threading.Event()
    startup_seconds = max(1, int(worker.load_settings().get("agent_startup_timeout", 180)))

    def startup_timeout():
        startup_expired.set()
        log("%s emitted no CLI output within %d seconds; stopping its process tree. Test the same model directly in a terminal before restarting." %
            (cli, startup_seconds))
        _kill(process)

    startup_timer = threading.Timer(startup_seconds, startup_timeout)
    startup_timer.daemon = True
    startup_timer.start()

    def expire():
        hit.append(True)
        log("  agent reached the %d-minute limit; checking progress." % minutes)
        _kill(process)

    timer = threading.Timer(minutes * 60, expire)
    timer.daemon = True
    timer.start()
    try:
        input_closed = False
        try:
            process.stdin.write(prompt)
            process.stdin.close()
            log("Prompt sent; waiting for CLI output.")
        except BrokenPipeError:
            input_closed = True
            log("Agent CLI closed input before accepting the prompt; startup output follows.")
            try:
                process.stdin.close()
            except BrokenPipeError:
                pass
        first_output = True
        for line in process.stdout:
            if first_output and not line.startswith("timestamp="):
                startup_timer.cancel()
                log("%s CLI output received." % cli)
                first_output = False
            show(line, log)
            if any(text in line for text in ("Illegal instruction", "Bun has crashed", "MemoryExhaustion", "panic(main thread):")):
                runtime_failed = True
                log("Agent runtime crashed before model output. Update/reinstall OpenCode or select another CLI; restarting unchanged runtime will fail again.")
            error = _error_text(line)
            if VARIANT.search(error):
                _kill(process)
                process.wait()
                return VARIANT_UNAVAILABLE
            if DEAD.search(error) or RATE.search(error):
                _kill(process)
                process.wait()
                return RATE_LIMITED
        code = process.wait()
        return (RUNTIME_FAILED if runtime_failed or startup_expired.is_set() else
                0 if triage and triage[1].is_set() else TIME_LIMIT if hit else code or int(input_closed))
    except BaseException:
        _kill(process)
        raise
    finally:
        if triage:
            triage[0].set()
        startup_timer.cancel()
        timer.cancel()
        process.stdout.close()


def interactive(cli, goal, model=None):
    """Open a normal Claude Code / Codex session here with the goal as its first message.

    This is the maintainer workflow: the person watches, answers permission
    prompts and steers. One line only: the Windows .cmd shims mangle newlines,
    quotes and percent signs in arguments.
    """
    exe = shutil.which(cli)
    if not exe:
        raise SystemExit("%s CLI not found. Install it and sign in first (see docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md)." % cli)
    goal = " ".join(goal.replace('"', "'").replace("%", " percent").split())
    sync_memory()  # refreshes work/agent-memory/shared-*.json for the session to read
    first = ("Goal: %s. Read CLAUDE.md first and follow its workflow. Read docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md, "
             "research/lessons.json, work/agent-memory/attempts.jsonl and the shared attempts in "
             "work/agent-memory/shared-*.json if present. "
             "Reuse verified lessons and shared tool/workflow suggestions; inspect prior failures and "
             "do not repeat them unchanged; record every trial, including failures, following the memory schema.") % goal
    try:
        return subprocess.call([exe] + (["--model", model] if model else []) + [first], cwd=ROOT)
    finally:
        sync_memory()


def work_one(api, user, agent_id, job, cli, model, minutes, log, shared=None):
    client, addr = job["client"], job["addr"]
    path = ROOT / "src" / client / ("%s.cpp" % addr)
    if not path.exists():
        best = {}
        if job.get("score"):
            try:
                best = api.call("/v1/source?client=%s&addr=%s" % (client, addr)) or {}
            except (worker.ApiFailure, OSError, ValueError):
                pass
        if best.get("source"):
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text(best["source"], encoding="utf-8")
        else:
            match.claim(client, addr)
    before_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    before = score(client, addr, path)
    log("%s %s  %s  %d bytes  %d%%  -> %s" % (client, addr, job.get("unit", ""), job.get("size", 0), before, path))
    stop = threading.Event()

    def beat():
        hb = worker.Api(",".join(api.servers), api.token)
        while not stop.wait(job.get("heartbeat", 60)):
            try:
                if not hb.call("/v1/heartbeat", {"lease": job["lease"]}).get("ok"):
                    return
            except RuntimeError:
                return

    threading.Thread(target=beat, daemon=True).start()
    try:
        prompt = PROMPT.format(client=client, path=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), unit=job.get("unit", "?"),
                               check="%s %s %s" % (check_command(), client, addr),
                               score=before, size=job.get("size", 0), memory=memory_prompt(memory(shared)))
        run_agent(cli, prompt, model, minutes, log)
    finally:
        stop.set()
    after = score(client, addr, path)
    job["receipt"] = None
    candidate, stored = after, None
    if after < before:
        path.write_text(before_text, encoding="utf-8")
        log("  agent left %d%% < %d%%; restored the previous file." % (after, before))
        after = before
    match.save_score(client, addr, after)
    if after > job.get("score", 0):
        r = api.call("/v1/submit", {"lease": job["lease"], "user": user, "worker": agent_id,
                                    "model": model or (cli + " (CLI default)"), "client": client, "addr": addr,
                                    "score": after, "source": path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")})
        log("  submitted: server stored %s%%" % r.get("stored"))
        job["receipt"] = r
        stored = r.get("stored")
    else:
        api.call("/v1/release", {"lease": job["lease"], "cooldown": 60})
        log("  no gain over the server's %d%%; released." % job.get("score", 0))
    record_session(client, addr, job.get("unit", ""), cli, before, candidate, after,
                   before_text, path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"), stored)
    return after


def run(server, user, token=None, cli="claude", model=None, client=None, jobs=1, max_size=256,
        minutes=120, log=print):
    api = worker.Api(server, token)
    have = worker.usable_clients(api.call("/v1/info"), log)
    if client:
        have = [name for name in have if name == client]
    if not have:
        raise SystemExit("No usable client%s on this PC (run: roc doctor)." % (" " + client if client else ""))
    agent_id = "agent-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    matched = 0
    shared = sync_memory(server, token, user, log)
    for _ in range(jobs):
        job = api.call("/v1/lease", {"user": user, "worker": agent_id, "clients": have, "mode": "ai",
                                     "model": "agent:" + cli, "max_size": max_size})["job"]
        if not job:
            log("No open functions right now.")
            break
        work_one(api, user, agent_id, job, cli, model, minutes, log, shared)
        receipt = job.get("receipt") or {}
        matched += bool(receipt.get("verified") and receipt.get("improved") and receipt.get("stored") == 100)
    log("Agent session: %d matched." % matched)
    sync_memory(server, token, user, log)


def function_evidence(row, functions):
    """Observed facts for a behavior hypothesis; never inferred layouts or ABIs."""
    evidence = {key: row[key][:8] if isinstance(row[key], list) else row[key]
                for key in ("calling_convention", "return_stack_bytes", "stack_args", "this_reads", "this_writes", "virtual_slots",
                            "imports", "strings", "entry_ecx_constructors", "constants", "global_reads", "global_writes") if row.get(key)}
    for key in ("callers", "call_targets"):
        # Score marks matched neighbours as read-only examples, not work targets.
        evidence[key] = [{"addr": addr, "unit": functions.get(addr, {}).get("unit", "unknown"),
                          **({"return_stack_bytes": functions[addr]["return_stack_bytes"][:8]}
                             if "return_stack_bytes" in functions.get(addr, {}) and
                             functions[addr].get("kind", "code") not in ("bad", "data") else {}),
                          **({"score": functions[addr]["score"]} if "score" in functions.get(addr, {}) else {}),
                          **({"matched_read_only": True} if functions.get(addr, {}).get("score") == 100 else {})}
                         for addr in row.get(key, [])[:4 if key == "callers" else 8]]
    if "strings" in evidence:
        evidence["strings"] = [value[:160] for value in evidence["strings"]]
    return evidence


def is_data_table(row):
    """True for analyzer rows that are really DATA (tables, switch maps, padding).

    0069ebd0 'Ogre::RbxSceneManager 4096 bytes' turned out to be a 256-entry
    16-stride table (pointer, index, flags, zero) — no source can ever match it,
    and as a 'family' it poisons ranking and burns agent cycles. Data decodes
    as `add byte ptr [eax], al` (00 00) runs and has no call graph.
    """
    shape = row.get("shape", "")
    if row.get("kind") == "data":
        return True
    if shape.count("add byte ptr [eax], al") > 8:
        return True
    if (shape and row.get("size", 0) >= 256 and not row.get("callers") and not row.get("call_targets")
            and (shape.count(";") < row.get("size", 0) // 32)):
        return True
    return False


def goal_targets(server, token, client, shared):
    from roc import agent_auto
    records = agent_auto.history() + shared.get("records", [])
    names = list(match.clients.load()) if client == "all" else [client]
    plan = agent_auto.portfolio(names, max_size=0, records=records, api=worker.Api(server, token), min_score=0,
                                random_targets=True)
    blocked = {(r.get("client"), addr, r.get("cohort")) for r in records if r.get("kind") == "goal_blocked"
               for addr in r.get("addresses", [])}
    # Sessions (hour buckets) that already worked a function without beating its current score, on any PC.
    sessions = defaultdict(set)
    for r in records:
        if r.get("kind") in ("agent_check", "trial", "session") and r.get("outcome") != "improved" and r.get("date"):
            addresses = r.get("addresses")
            for addr in addresses if isinstance(addresses, list) else ():
                if isinstance(addr, str):  # shared records from other PCs are not always well formed
                    sessions[(str(r.get("client")), addr)].add(str(r["date"])[:13])
    tries = {key: len(hours) for key, hours in sessions.items()}
    targets = [row for area in plan["areas"] for row in area["targets"] if not row["group_parked"]
               and (row["client"], row["addr"], row["evidence_hash"]) not in blocked
               and tries.get((row["client"], row["addr"]), 0) < GOAL_MAX_TRIES
               and not is_data_table(row)]
    for row in targets:
        row["prior_sessions"] = tries.get((row["client"], row["addr"]), 0)
    return [dict(row, selection="random") for row in random.sample(targets, min(24, len(targets)))]


def run_goal(cli, goal, model=None, minutes=120, log=print, continuous=False,
             server=None, token=None, user=None, client="2008-06"):
    """One open-ended session, e.g. "match as many 2008-06 RakNet functions as you can"."""
    if server:
        from roc import agent_auto
        agent_auto.prepare_clients(client, log)
        totals = agent_auto.run(server, user, token, cli, model, workers=1, jobs=24, max_size=0,
            minutes=minutes, batch_size=1, batch_minutes=min(10, minutes), individual=True,
            log=log, client=client, continuous=continuous, goal=goal)
        return 1 if totals["errors"] else 0
    log("Agent goal (%s, up to %d min): %s" % (cli, minutes, goal))
    recent = []
    cycle = 0
    failures = 0
    scratch = ROOT / "work" / "agent-goals" / (os.environ.get("ROC_TASK_ID") or uuid.uuid4().hex[:12])
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if server:
        from roc import agent_auto
        agent_auto.prepare_clients(client, log)
    while True:
        log("Preparing goal: syncing experiment memory.")
        shared = sync_memory(server, token, user, log=log)
        log("Preparing goal: loading paged server targets; AI starts after shortlist is ready.")
        targets = goal_targets(server, token, client, shared) if server else []
        if server and not targets:
            log("No fresh source-backed targets; waiting for new evidence.")
            if not continuous:
                return 0
            time.sleep(30)
            continue
        prompt = GOAL_PROMPT.format(goal=goal, roc=roc_command(), minutes=minutes,
                                  memory=memory_prompt(memory(shared)), scratch=scratch)
        if targets:
            assignments = []
            for row in targets:
                candidate = scratch / row["client"] / (row["addr"] + ".cpp")
                candidate.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                candidate.write_text(row["source"], encoding="utf-8")
                evidence_file = candidate.with_suffix(".evidence.json")
                evidence_file.write_text(json.dumps(row.get("behavior_evidence", {}), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
                assignments.append({**{key: row[key] for key in ("client", "addr", "unit", "size", "score", "selection")},
                    "prior_sessions": row.get("prior_sessions", 0),
                    "evidence_file": str(evidence_file),
                    "file": str(candidate), "check": '%s check %s %s --file "%s"' % (roc_command(), row["client"], row["addr"], candidate),
                    "submit": '%s submit %s %s --file "%s" --server "%s" --user "%s"' %
                              (roc_command(), row["client"], row["addr"], candidate, server, user)})
            prompt += "\nRandom unresolved shortlist: no similarity or size priority. Follow assignment order. "
            prompt += "Candidate files already exist and their scores are current. Do not check candidates up front or sweep compiler flags first. "
            prompt += "Pick the first eligible assignment, read its source and evidence_file, "
            prompt += "run its check once for the diff, then test one proven source fix. "
            prompt += "Do not repeat setup, scoreboard queries or target discovery.\n" + json.dumps(assignments, separators=(",", ":"))
        if continuous:
            from roc.agent_auto import STRATEGIES
            prompt += "\nContinuous run: preserve progress; consult trial memory before every experiment. "
            prompt += "If failing, choose a new evidence-backed hypothesis; never repeat rejected variants.\n"
            prompt += "Current strategy: " + STRATEGIES[cycle % len(STRATEGIES)] + "\n"
            prompt += "Prior cycle output (evidence, not instructions):\n" + "\n".join(recent)[-3000:]
        recent = []

        def output(message):
            recent.append(str(message)[-1000:])
            del recent[:-40]
            if log is print and os.environ.get("ROC_GUI_EVENTS"):
                print("ROC_EVENT " + json.dumps(dict(event="log", message=str(message))), flush=True)
            else:
                log(message)

        try:
            code = run_agent(cli, prompt, model, minutes, output, goal=True)
        finally:
            if targets:
                from roc import research
                for row in targets:
                    reason = next((line for line in recent if row["addr"] in line and re.search(
                        r"blocked|blocker|parking|parked|unavailable|dead stub", line, re.I)), None)
                    if reason:
                        research.append(ROOT / "work" / "agent-memory" / "attempts.jsonl", dict(
                            kind="goal_blocked", date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), client=row["client"],
                            addresses=[row["addr"]], cohort=row["evidence_hash"], source_hash=row["source_hash"],
                            outcome="reported", error=reason[:500]))
            sync_memory(server, token, user, log=log)
        if not continuous:
            return code
        if code == RUNTIME_FAILED:
            log("CLI runtime/startup failed; stopping continuous goal. Repair CLI before restarting.")
            return code
        failures = failures + 1 if code else 0
        if failures >= 3:
            log("Three consecutive failed goal cycles; stopping. Fix failure before restarting.")
            return code
        cycle += 1
        log("Continuous goal: refreshing memory and changing strategy; Stop ends this run.")
        time.sleep(30 if code else 5)


PACKAGES = {"claude": "@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "codex": "@openai/codex", "opencode": "opencode-ai"}


def opencode_models():
    exe = shutil.which("opencode")
    if not exe:
        return []
    try:
        # OpenCode 2 hides this catalog at its default log level.  Debug output
        # still contains only public provider/model identifiers.
        result = subprocess.run([exe, "models", "--log-level", "debug"], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
                                errors="replace", timeout=90)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        raise ValueError("OpenCode model listing timed out; click Refresh models to try again")
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError(result.stderr.strip() or "OpenCode model listing failed")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]", "", result.stdout)
    out = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = re.search(r"(\S+/\S+)", line)
        if match:
            model = match.group(1)
            if model not in out:
                out.append(model)
    return out


def status():
    """What the dashboard's Agent page shows: CLIs, sign-in prerequisites, project readiness."""
    from roc import clients, setup
    out = {"clis": {}}
    for cli in CLIS:
        exe = shutil.which(cli)
        version = None
        if exe:
            try:
                version = subprocess.run([exe, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                         timeout=15).stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]
            except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, IndexError):
                version = "installed"
        out["clis"][cli] = version
    s = worker.load_settings()
    out["npm"] = bool(shutil.which("npm"))
    out["server"], out["user"] = bool(s.get("server")), bool(s.get("user"))
    cl_paths = setup.CL_PATHS + sorted(setup.TOOLS.glob("*/**/VC/bin/cl.exe"))
    out["compilers"] = any(path.exists() for path in cl_paths)
    entry = clients.load().get("2008-06")
    out["client"] = {"name": "2008-06", "downloaded": bool(entry) and clients.status("2008-06", entry) == "ok",
                     "analyzed": (ROOT / "work" / "2008-06" / "functions.jsonl").exists()}
    out["memory"] = memory()
    return out


def _terminal(argv):
    """Run argv in a new visible console so the person can sign in, watch and steer."""
    if os.name == "nt":
        subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE)
        return None
    for term in ("x-terminal-emulator", "gnome-terminal", "konsole", "xterm"):
        if shutil.which(term):
            subprocess.Popen([term, "--" if term == "gnome-terminal" else "-e", *argv], cwd=ROOT)
            return None
    return " ".join(argv)


def open_session(cli, goal, model=None):
    """New terminal running `roc agent CLI --interactive`; returns a command to run by hand if none opens."""
    if cli not in CLIS:
        raise ValueError("Choose claude, codex or opencode")
    goal = str(goal or "").strip()
    if not goal or len(goal) > 2000:
        raise ValueError("Describe the goal (up to 2000 characters)")
    argv = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "roc.py"), "agent", cli, "--interactive", "--goal", goal]
    return _terminal(argv + (["--model", model] if model else []))


def open_setup(cli):
    """New terminal that installs the CLI if needed, then starts it so the person can sign in."""
    if cli not in CLIS:
        raise ValueError("Choose claude, codex or opencode")
    # OpenCode signs in through its own auth command; the others open their TUI.
    sign_in = ["opencode auth login"] if cli == "opencode" else [cli]
    steps = ([] if shutil.which(cli) else ["npm install -g " + PACKAGES[cli]]) + sign_in
    if os.name == "nt":
        return _terminal(["cmd", "/k", " && ".join(steps)])
    return _terminal(["sh", "-c", " && ".join(steps) + "; exec sh"])

import json
import math
import re
import sqlite3
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from roc.integration import CLIENT, atomic_json, digest
from roc.reports import RATE_WINDOW, fmt_duration, inline_code, server_mines_webhook


def partial_payload(user, model, rows):
    lines = []
    for row in rows[:12]:
        detail = []
        if row['frame_ok'] and not row['frame_before']:
            detail.append('frame improved')
        if row['calls_ok'] and not row['calls_before']:
            detail.append('calls improved')
        lines.append('`%s` **%.3f%% → %.3f%%** %s%s' % (row['addr'], row['previous'], row['score'],
            inline_code(row['file']), ' · ' + ', '.join(detail) if detail else ''))
    if len(rows) > 12:
        lines.append('+%d more partial improvements' % (len(rows) - 12))
    return {'allowed_mentions': {'parse': []}, 'embeds': [{
        'title': '🟡 RoConstruct Native Partial Improvements', 'color': 0xEAB308,
        'description': ('**2008-06 Client**\nLocal compiler search observations · not server-verified exacts.\n\n' + '\n'.join(lines))[:4096],
        'fields': [{'name': 'Worker', 'value': inline_code(user), 'inline': True},
                   {'name': 'Model', 'value': inline_code(model), 'inline': True},
                   {'name': 'Credit', 'value': '0 exact credits · verified coverage unchanged', 'inline': False}],
        'timestamp': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}]}


def record_partials(promotions, user, body):
    """Bounded contributor observations. Separate telemetry table; no scoring/credit writes."""
    revision, model, rows = body.get('base_revision'), body.get('model'), body.get('partials')
    if not isinstance(model, str) or not 1 <= len(model.strip()) <= 120:
        raise ValueError('Partial reports need actual model identity')
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not 1 <= len(rows) <= 64:
        raise ValueError('Need 1-64 partial observations')
    manifest = promotions.root / 'rebuild/2008-06/manifests/functions.json'
    targets = {r['addr'] for r in json.loads(manifest.read_text()) if r.get('score') == 100 and r.get('unit', '').startswith('RBX::')}
    clean = []
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError('Invalid partial observation')
        path = PurePosixPath(row.get('file', ''))
        if (len(str(path)) > 260 or '\\' in str(path) or ':' in str(path)
                or path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or len(path.parts) < 2 or path.as_posix() != row.get('file')
                or path.parts[0] not in ('App', 'Network', 'RbxView', 'RbxGraphics', 'Rendering') or path.suffix != '.cpp'):
            raise ValueError('Invalid partial source path')
        if row.get('addr') not in targets or row.get('base_revision') != revision:
            raise ValueError('Unknown partial target or baseline')
        for key in ('previous', 'score'):
            if type(row.get(key)) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(row[key]) or not 0 <= row[key] <= 100:
                raise ValueError('Invalid partial score')
        for key in ('frame_before', 'frame_ok', 'calls_before', 'calls_ok'):
            if type(row.get(key)) is not bool:
                raise ValueError('Invalid partial structural metric')
        for key in ('source_sha256', 'object_sha256'):
            if not isinstance(row.get(key), str) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', row[key]):
                raise ValueError('Partial source/object hashes required')
        if not (row['score'] > row['previous'] or row['frame_ok'] and not row['frame_before'] or row['calls_ok'] and not row['calls_before']):
            raise ValueError('Partial report contains no improvement')
        clean.append({k: row[k] for k in ('file', 'addr', 'previous', 'score', 'frame_before', 'frame_ok',
                      'calls_before', 'calls_ok', 'source_sha256', 'object_sha256')})
    fresh = []
    with promotions.store.lock, promotions.store.db as db:
        if not isinstance(revision, str) or not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM integration_bases WHERE revision=?', (revision,)).fetchone():
            raise ValueError('Unknown partial baseline revision')
        db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_partial_observations('
                   'revision TEXT,file TEXT,addr TEXT,score REAL,frame_ok INTEGER,calls_ok INTEGER,'
                   'user TEXT,model TEXT,observation TEXT,updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(revision,file,addr))')
        for row in clean:
            key = revision, row['file'], row['addr']
            previous = db.execute('SELECT score,frame_ok,calls_ok FROM integration_partial_observations WHERE revision=? AND file=? AND addr=?', key).fetchone()
            if previous and row['score'] <= previous[0] and row['frame_ok'] <= previous[1] and row['calls_ok'] <= previous[2]:
                continue
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO integration_partial_observations VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                (*key, max(row['score'], previous[0]) if previous else row['score'],
                 row['frame_ok'] or bool(previous and previous[1]), row['calls_ok'] or bool(previous and previous[2]),
                 user, model, json.dumps(row), time.time()))
            fresh.append(row)
    url = server_mines_webhook()
    if fresh and url:
        from roc.reports import _post
        import threading
        threading.Thread(target=_post, args=(url, partial_payload(user, model, fresh)), daemon=True).start()
    return dict(recorded=len(fresh), local_only=True, exact_credits=0)


def payload(promotions, job, receipt=None):
    store, root = promotions.store, promotions.root
    with store.lock:
        credits = store.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_credit WHERE user=?", (job["user"],)).fetchone()[0]
        recent = store.db.execute("SELECT receipt FROM integration_jobs WHERE state='accepted' AND updated>=?",
                                  (time.time() - RATE_WINDOW,)).fetchall()
        state = store.db.execute("SELECT phase FROM integration_jobs WHERE id=?", (job["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        scores = dict(store.db.execute("SELECT addr,score FROM funcs WHERE client=?", (CLIENT,)).fetchall())
    proof = promotions.directory / "progress-native.json"
    functions = {}
    description = "**2008-06 Client**\n\nEstablishing verified native baseline..."
    if proof.exists():
        native = set(json.loads(proof.read_text())["addresses"])
        from roc.integration_site import coverage
        groups, functions = coverage(root, scores, native)
        counts = [groups["integrated"]["functions"], groups["exact_waiting"]["functions"], groups["partial"]["functions"] + groups["unmined"]["functions"]]
        sizes = [groups["integrated"]["bytes"], groups["exact_waiting"]["bytes"], groups["partial"]["bytes"] + groups["unmined"]["bytes"]]
        total = sum(sizes)
        cells = [s * 23 // total if total else 0 for s in sizes]
        for i in sorted(range(3), key=lambda i: sizes[i] * 23 % total if total else 0, reverse=True)[:23 - sum(cells)]:
            cells[i] += 1
        bar = "".join(c * n for c, n in zip(("\U0001f7ea", "\U0001f7e6", "\u2b1c"), cells))
        description = ("**2008-06 Client**\n%s / %s integrated \u00b7 %s remaining\n\n%s **%.2f%%** of target bytes\n\n"
            "\U0001f7ea integrated \u00b7 \U0001f7e6 exact waiting \u00b7 \u2b1c not integrated") % (
                format(counts[0], ","), format(sum(counts), ","), format(sum(counts[1:]), ","),
                bar, 100 * sizes[0] / total if total else 0)
        description += "\n%s / %s target bytes" % (format(sizes[0], ","), format(total, ","))
        remaining = sum(sizes[1:])
    else:
        remaining = None
    recent_gains = {addr for row in recent for addr in json.loads(row[0]).get("gains", [])
                    if addr in functions}
    rate = len(recent_gains) * 3600 / RATE_WINDOW
    byte_rate = sum(functions[addr]["size"] for addr in recent_gains) / RATE_WINDOW
    eta = "collecting rate" if not byte_rate or remaining is None else "~" + fmt_duration(remaining / byte_rate)
    if remaining == 0:
        eta = "0s"
    accepted = receipt and receipt.get("accepted")
    rejected = receipt is not None and not accepted
    delta = receipt.get("credits", 0) if accepted else 0
    gains = receipt.get("gains", []) if accepted else []
    matched = "\n".join("\U0001f7e3 **100%%** `%s` %s \u00b7 %s B" % (
        addr, functions.get(addr, {}).get("unit", "?"), functions.get(addr, {}).get("size", "?"))
        for addr in gains[:10]) or "None"
    if len(gains) > 10:
        matched += "\n+%d more integrated" % (len(gains) - 10)
    fields = [
        {"name": "\U0001f7e3 Fully Integrated", "value": matched[:1024], "inline": False},
        {"name": "\u26a1 Integration Rate", "value": "**%g functions/hr** \u00b7 **%s B/hr** *(last 6h)* \u00b7 byte ETA %s" % (round(rate, 1), format(round(byte_rate * 3600), ","), eta), "inline": True},
        {"name": "\U0001f3c6 Workers", "value": "**%s** \u00b7 %s pts \u00b7 %s native integrated *(+%d)*" % (
            job["user"], format(store.user_points(job["user"]), ","), format(credits, ","), delta), "inline": True},
        {"name": "\u2699\ufe0f Verification", "value": "server-verified \u00b7 %d integrated" % len(gains) if accepted else "rejected \u00b7 no native credit" if rejected else state, "inline": True},
        {"name": "\U0001f527 Models", "value": inline_code(job["model"]), "inline": True},
    ]
    if accepted:
        fields.append({"name": "\U0001f7ea Rebuild Ownership", "value": "**%s owned** (+%d) \u00b7 **%s distinct** (+%d)" % (
            format(receipt["owned_after"], ","), receipt["owned_after"] - receipt["owned_before"],
            format(receipt["distinct_after"], ","), receipt["distinct_after"] - receipt["distinct_before"]), "inline": False})
    return {"allowed_mentions": {"parse": []}, "embeds": [{"title": "\u26cf\ufe0f RoConstruct Integration Digest",
        "description": description, "color": 0xA855F7, "fields": fields,
        "footer": {"text": "RoConstruct Integration"},
        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}]}


def notify(promotions, job, receipt=None):
    url = server_mines_webhook()
    # Post only real progress: an accepted job that integrated something. Phase changes, retries, merges
    # and rejections changed the digest every time and flooded the channel with zero-gain messages.
    if not url or not (receipt and receipt.get("accepted") and receipt.get("gains")):
        return
    try:
        body = payload(promotions, job, receipt)
        state_path = promotions.directory / "discord.json"
        state = json.loads(state_path.read_text()) if state_path.exists() else {}
        content = dict(body["embeds"][0])
        content.pop("timestamp")
        key = digest(content)
        if state.get("digest") == key:
            return
        parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        target = urllib.parse.urlunsplit(parts._replace(query="wait=true"))
        request = urllib.request.Request(target, json.dumps(body).encode(),
            {"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "RoConstruct-Native/1.0"}, method="POST")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
            result = json.loads(response.read() or b"{}")
        atomic_json(state_path, {"message_id": result["id"], "digest": key})
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, sqlite3.Error, urllib.error.URLError):
        # Optional reporting cannot reject independently verified code.
        return

        state_path = promotions.directory / "discord.json"
        state = json.loads(state_path.read_text()) if state_path.exists() else {}
        content = dict(body["embeds"][0])
        content.pop("timestamp")
        key = digest(content)
        if state.get("digest") == key:
            return
        parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        target = urllib.parse.urlunsplit(parts._replace(query="wait=true"))
        request = urllib.request.Request(target, json.dumps(body).encode(),
            {"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "RoConstruct-Native/1.0"}, method="POST")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
            result = json.loads(response.read() or b"{}")
        atomic_json(state_path, {"message_id": result["id"], "digest": key})
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, sqlite3.Error, urllib.error.URLError):
        # Optional reporting cannot reject independently verified code.
        return

roc/integration_site.py.base:
"""docs/integration.json: native integration progress for the website (2008-06 rbxgs rebuild).
Same four groups as the Discord digest: integrated (linked rebuild reproduces it), exact waiting (mined 100%,
not yet integrated), partial, unmined. Per-function data is published on gh-pages only (see server.publish_pages)."""
import json
import re
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from roc.integration import CLIENT, ROOT, atomic_json

def readable(symbol):
    """MSVC decorated name -> Namespace::Class::method (enough for labels; full name stays in 'symbol')."""
    m = re.match(r"\?\?([01])([A-Za-z_]\w*)@((?:[A-Za-z_]\w*@)*)@", symbol)
    if m:
        scope = [m[2]] + [p for p in m[3].split("@") if p]
        cls = "::".join(reversed(scope))
        return "%s::%s%s" % (cls, "~" if m[1] == "1" else "", m[2])
    m = re.match(r"\?([A-Za-z_]\w*)@((?:[A-Za-z_]\w*@)+)@", symbol)
    if m:
        return "::".join(list(reversed([p for p in m[2].split("@") if p])) + [m[1]])
    return symbol


def coverage(root, scores, native):
    """Website and webhook share the same code-only function/byte denominator."""
    groups = {key: {"functions": 0, "bytes": 0} for key in ("integrated", "exact_waiting", "partial", "unmined")}
    functions = {}
    for line in (root / "work" / CLIENT / "functions.jsonl").read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        f = json.loads(line)
        if f.get("kind", "code") != "code":
            continue
        functions[f["addr"]] = f
        score = scores.get(f["addr"], 0)
        key = "integrated" if f["addr"] in native else "exact_waiting" if score == 100 else "partial" if score else "unmined"
        groups[key]["functions"] += 1
        groups[key]["bytes"] += f["size"]
    return groups, functions


def build(root=ROOT, log=print):
    out = root / "rebuild" / CLIENT / "out"
    native_path = root / "work/integration/progress-native.json"
    native = set(json.loads(native_path.read_text())["addresses"]) if native_path.exists() else set()
    names_path = out / "native-names.json"
    names = json.loads(names_path.read_text()) if names_path.exists() else {}
    db = sqlite3.connect("file:%s?mode=ro" % (root / "work/server.db").as_posix(), uri=True, timeout=30)
    try:
        scores = dict(db.execute("SELECT addr,score FROM funcs WHERE client=?", (CLIENT,)).fetchall())
        jobs = db.execute("SELECT id,user,model,unit,receipt,updated FROM integration_jobs WHERE state='accepted' "
                          "ORDER BY updated DESC").fetchall()
        leaders = db.execute("SELECT user,model,COUNT(*) FROM integration_credit WHERE client=? GROUP BY user,model "
                             "ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC", (CLIENT,)).fetchall()
    finally:
        db.close()
    groups, _ = coverage(root, scores, native)
    units = {job: unit for job, _, _, unit, _, _ in jobs}
    receipts = []
    daily = {}
    seen = set()
    for job, user, model, unit, receipt, updated in jobs:
        r = json.loads(receipt or "{}")
        key = r.get("job", job)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        day = datetime.fromtimestamp(updated, ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        row = daily.setdefault(day, {"day": day, "gains": 0, "jobs": 0, "models": {}})
        gains = len(r.get("new_distinct", r.get("gains", [])))
        row["gains"] += gains
        row["jobs"] += 1
        series = row["models"].setdefault(model or "Unknown", {"gains": 0, "jobs": 0})
        series["gains"] += gains
        series["jobs"] += 1
        unit = ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(units.get(j, "") for j in r.get("merged_jobs", [job])))
        receipts.append({"job": key[:8], "user": user, "model": model, "units": unit[:120],
                         "gains": len(r.get("gains", [])), "distinct_gains": len(r.get("new_distinct", r.get("gains", []))), "owned_after": r.get("owned_after"),
                         "when": datetime.fromtimestamp(updated, timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")})
    shown = {a: names[a] for a in names if a in native or (names[a].get("score") or 0) >= 50}
    links_path = root / 'local/findings/2008-06/verification/native-source-links.json'
    sources = json.loads(links_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if links_path.exists() else {}
    data = {"client": CLIENT, "updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"),
            "groups": groups,
            "native": sorted(native),
            "sources": {a: value for a, value in sources.items() if a in native},
            # addr -> [readable name, decorated symbol, rebuilt score (100 = integrated)]
            "names": {a: [readable(v["symbol"]), v["symbol"], 100 if a in native else v.get("score")] for a, v in sorted(shown.items())},
            "daily": [daily[day] for day in sorted(daily)],
            "jobs": receipts[:100],
            "leaderboard": [{"user": u, "model": m, "native_credits": n} for u, m, n in leaders]}
    path = root / "docs/integration.json"
    previous = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else {}
    history = {row["day"]: row for row in previous.get("history", [])} if previous.get("client") == CLIENT else {}
    day = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    history[day] = {"day": day, "groups": data["groups"]}
    data["history"] = [history[day] for day in sorted(history)]
    atomic_json(root / "docs/integration.json", data)
    log("Integration site data: %d integrated, %d named" % (len(native), len(data["names"])))
    return data


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build()

def matching_files(recipe, folder):
    """Include portable recovered units even when the vendor glob omits their directory."""
    files = {file.replace("\\", "/") for file in files_of(recipe, folder)}
    files.update(file for file in generated_units().get(recipe["src"], {})
                 if file.endswith(".cpp") and (folder / file).is_file())
    return sorted(files)

def archive_members(path):
    """(member name, COFF bytes) from a Microsoft .lib archive."""
    data = path.read_bytes()
    if not data.startswith(b"!<arch>\n"):
        raise match.CompileError("not a COFF archive: %s" % path)
    names, off = b"", 8
    while off + 60 <= len(data):
        head = data[off:off + 60]
        try:
            size = int(head[48:58].decode("ascii").strip())
        except ValueError:
            raise match.CompileError("bad COFF archive: %s" % path)
        raw = head[:16].rstrip()
        body = data[off + 60:off + 60 + size]
        off += 60 + size + (size & 1)
        if raw == b"//":
            names = body
            continue
        if raw == b"/":
            continue
        if raw.startswith(b"/") and raw[1:].isdigit():
            start = int(raw[1:])
            end = names.find(b"\0", start)
            raw = names[start:end if end >= 0 else len(names)]
        elif raw.startswith(b"#1/"):
            length = int(raw[3:])
            raw, body = body[:length], body[length:]
        yield raw.decode("latin-1").rstrip("/"), body

def archive_unit(name, path, build):
    """Exact COFF member named by a saved CRT match."""
    r = RECIPES.get(name)
    if not r or not r.get("archive"):
        raise match.CompileError("unknown archive %r" % name)
    library, _, member = path.partition("/")
    cl = setup.compilers().get(build)
    if not cl or library not in r["files"]:
        raise match.CompileError("no archive %r for compiler %s" % library, build)
    lib = _archive_dir(r, cl) / library
    for found, obj in archive_members(lib):
        if found.replace("\\", "/") == member.replace("\\", "/"):  # source_for writes "/"
            return obj
    raise match.CompileError("no member %r in %s" % (member, lib))

def _archive_dir(r, cl):
    """Static libs ship beside the compiler unless the recipe names its own folder."""
    return LIBS / r["lib_dir"] if r.get("lib_dir") else Path(cl).parents[1] / "lib"

def archive_files(r, build):
    folder = _archive_dir(r, setup.compilers()[build])
    return [(lib, member, obj) for lib in r["files"] for member, obj in archive_members(folder / lib)]

def template_units():
    """Generated .cpp files: explicit instantiations of std/boost templates Roblox code uses.
    Explicit instantiation emits every member, so each unit fingerprints a whole family."""
    elems = {
        "ptr": "struct T; typedef T* E;", "int": "typedef int E;", "float": "typedef float E;",
        "double": "typedef double E;", "string": "#include <string>\ntypedef std::string E;",
        "sp": "#include <boost/shared_ptr.hpp>\nstruct T; typedef boost::shared_ptr<T> E;",
        "wp": "#include <boost/weak_ptr.hpp>\nstruct T; typedef boost::weak_ptr<T> E;",
        "spc": "#include <boost/shared_ptr.hpp>\nstruct T; typedef boost::shared_ptr<const T> E;",
        "pod12": "struct E { float v[3]; };", "pod16": "struct E { float v[4]; };",
        "pod48": "struct E { float v[12]; };",
    }
    containers = {
        "vector": "#include <vector>\ntemplate class std::vector<E>;",
        "list": "#include <list>\ntemplate class std::list<E>;",
        "deque": "#include <deque>\ntemplate class std::deque<E>;",
        "map_int": "#include <map>\ntemplate class std::map<int, E>;",
        "map_str": "#include <map>\n#include <string>\ntemplate class std::map<std::string, E>;",
        "map_ptr": "#include <map>\nstruct K; template class std::map<K*, E>;",
        "set": "#include <set>\ntemplate class std::set<E>;",
    }
    out = {}
    for cn, ct in containers.items():
        for en, et in elems.items():
            if cn == "set" and en.startswith("pod"):
                continue
            out["%s_%s.cpp" % (cn, en)] = "%s\n%s\n" % (et, ct)
    # Explicit map instantiation does not emit inherited _Tree::erase. The call
    # anchors that authentic body; 2008's large checked erasers use the Od gate.
    out["tree_erase_map_int.cpp"] = (
        "#define _DLL\n#include <map>\ntemplate class std::map<int, int>;\n"
        "std::map<int, int>::iterator eraseOne(std::map<int, int>& tree,\n"
        "                                    std::map<int, int>::iterator position) {\n"
        "    return tree.erase(position);\n}\n")
    sigs = {"v": "void ()", "i": "void (int)", "p": "void (T*)", "sp": "void (boost::shared_ptr<T>)",
            "b": "void (bool)", "f": "void (float)", "pp": "void (T*, T*)", "s": "void (const std::string&)"}
    for sn, sig in sigs.items():
        head = "#include <string>\n#include <boost/shared_ptr.hpp>\nstruct T;\n"
        out["function_%s.cpp" % sn] = head + "#include <boost/function.hpp>\ntemplate class boost::function<%s>;\n" % sig
        out["signal_%s.cpp" % sn] = head + "#include <boost/signal.hpp>\ntemplate class boost::signal<%s>;\n" % sig
    return out
