import struct

from roc import match, rebuild


def graph(monkeypatch, addend=0, external=False, duplicate_leaf=False, duplicate_callback=False, opcode=0xe9, cycle=False, conflicting=False):
    bodies = [b'\xb8\0\0\0\0\xc3', bytes([opcode])+struct.pack('<i',addend), b'\x68\0\0\0\0\xc3', b'Name\0']
    refs = [[(1,3,6)], [(1,4 if external else 2 if cycle else 0,20)], [(1,1,6)], []]
    if conflicting:
        bodies[2]=b'\x68\0\0\0\0\xe9\0\0\0\0'
        refs[2].append((6,0,20))
    names = [b'_leaf',b'_cb',b'_wrap',b'_tag',b'_ext']
    offset=20+4*40
    raw=[]
    for body in bodies:
        raw.append(offset); offset+=len(body)
    reloc=[]
    for group in refs:
        reloc.append(offset); offset+=10*len(group)
    header=struct.pack('<HHIIIHH',0x14c,4,0,offset,len(names),0,0)
    sections=b''.join(struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI',name.ljust(8,b'\0'),0,0,len(body),ptr,rptr,0,len(group),0,
                                  0x60000020 if i<3 else 0x40000040)
                      for i,(name,body,ptr,rptr,group) in enumerate(zip([b'.text$L',b'.text$C',b'.text$W',b'.rdata'],bodies,raw,reloc,refs)))
    symbols=b''.join(struct.pack('<8sIhHBB',name.ljust(8,b'\0'),0,i+1 if i<4 else 0,0x20 if i<3 else 0,2,0)
                     for i,name in enumerate(names))
    obj=header+sections+b''.join(bodies)+b''.join(struct.pack('<IIH',*r) for group in refs for r in group)+symbols+struct.pack('<I',4)
    image=bytearray(512); image[256:261]=b'Name\0'; image[272:277]=b'Name\0' if duplicate_leaf else b'Else\0'
    targets={'00500000':b'\xb8'+struct.pack('<I',0x500100)+b'\xc3',
             '00500010':b'\xb8'+struct.pack('<I',0x500110)+b'\xc3',
             '00500020':bytes([opcode])+struct.pack('<i',0x500000-0x500020-5),
             '00500030':bytes([opcode])+struct.pack('<i',(0x500000 if duplicate_callback else 0x500010)-0x500030-5),
             '00500040':b'\x68'+struct.pack('<I',0x500020)+b'\xc3',
             '00500050':b'\x68'+struct.pack('<I',0x500030)+b'\xc3'}
    choices={'_leaf':['00500000','00500010'],'_cb':['00500020','00500030'],'_wrap':['00500040','00500050']}
    if conflicting:
        targets['00500040']=b'\x68'+struct.pack('<I',0x500020)+b'\xe9'+struct.pack('<i',0x500010-0x500040-10)
        targets['00500050']=b'\x68'+struct.pack('<I',0x500030)+b'\xe9'+struct.pack('<i',0x500000-0x500050-10)
    monkeypatch.setattr(match,'_image',lambda client:(0x500000,bytes(image)))
    monkeypatch.setattr(match,'_base_relocs',lambda client:frozenset())
    monkeypatch.setattr(match,'target',lambda client,address:(targets[address],[1],{}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild,'pair',lambda client,funcs:[(s,len(b),choices[s]) for s,b,r in funcs])
    return obj


def test_data_leaf_resolves_jump_then_pushed_callback(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj)==[('_leaf',6,['00500000']),('_cb',5,['00500020']),('_wrap',6,['00500040'])]


def test_filtered_wrapper_still_checks_callees_outside_discovery_subset(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040'])]


def test_ambiguous_data_leaf_cannot_bootstrap_caller_ownership(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,duplicate_leaf=True)
    assert all(len(hits)==2 for _,_,hits in rebuild.pair_object('test',obj))


def test_identical_callee_destinations_preserve_callback_ambiguity(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,duplicate_callback=True)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040','00500050'])]


def test_external_callee_without_object_definition_is_not_an_anchor(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,external=True)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040','00500050'])]


def test_nonzero_code_addend_is_not_guessed(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,addend=4)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040','00500050'])]


def test_non_branch_relocation_does_not_become_a_call(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,opcode=0x90)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040','00500050'])]


def test_call_cycle_cannot_bootstrap_unique_ownership(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,cycle=True)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040','00500050'])]


def test_callee_proof_cannot_waive_missing_caller_data(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch)
    original=match.coff_data_refs
    monkeypatch.setattr(match,'coff_data_refs',lambda data,symbol,**kwargs:
                        [(999,b'Name',[])] if symbol=='_wrap' else original(data,symbol,**kwargs))
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,['00500040','00500050'])]


def test_callee_proof_cannot_waive_mismatched_caller_data(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch)
    original=match.coff_data_refs
    monkeypatch.setattr(match,'coff_data_refs',lambda data,symbol,**kwargs:
                        [(1,b'Wrong',[])] if symbol=='_wrap' else original(data,symbol,**kwargs))
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',6,[])]


def test_all_known_callee_constraints_must_agree(monkeypatch):
    obj=graph(monkeypatch,conflicting=True)
    assert rebuild.pair_object('test',obj,{'_wrap'})==[('_wrap',10,[])]

def test_windows_overlay_alias_preserves_accepted_fp_pragma(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from roc import rebuild
    source = tmp_path / 'tools/rbxgs/Client/App/gui/GUI.cpp'
    source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    source.write_text('#include "gui/Gui.h"\n\t\tRBXASSERT(!focus);\n\t\treturn processNonFocus(event);')
    base = {'App/gui/GUI.cpp': [['#include "gui/Gui.h"\n', '#pragma float_control(precise, off)\n#include "gui/Gui.h"\n']]}
    edits = {'App/gui/Gui.cpp': [['\t\tRBXASSERT(!focus);\n\t\treturn processNonFocus(event);', '\t\treturn processNonFocus(event);']]}
    combined, kept, dropped = integration_verify.preflight(tmp_path, base, edits)
    assert list(combined) == ['App/gui/GUI.cpp'] and not dropped
    assert integration.overlay_delta(base, combined) == kept
    registry = tmp_path / 'patches.json'
    registry.write_text(json.dumps(combined))
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'ROOT', tmp_path)
    spec = {'root': 'tools/rbxgs/Client', 'patches': 'patches.json'}
    _, overlay = rebuild.build_overlay('2008-06', 'RbxgsApp', spec)
    text = (overlay / 'App/gui/GUI.cpp').read_text()
    assert text.startswith('#pragma float_control(precise, off)') and 'RBXASSERT' not in text
    registry.write_text(json.dumps(dict(base, **edits)))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Case-colliding'):
        rebuild.build_overlay('2008-06', 'RbxgsApp', spec)
    assert (overlay / 'App/gui/GUI.cpp').read_text() == text
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Case-colliding'):
        integration.merge_patches({}, dict(base, **edits))

def test_native_partial_webhook_dedupes_without_score_or_credit_changes(promotions, monkeypatch):
    from roc import reports
    revision = promotions.baseline()['revision']
    row = dict(file='App/Test.cpp', addr='00500000', previous=70, score=80,
               frame_before=False, frame_ok=True, calls_before=False, calls_ok=False,
               source_sha256='a'*64, object_sha256='b'*64, base_revision=revision)
    body = dict(base_revision=revision, model='gpt-6.1-sol', partials=[row])
    sent = []
    class ImmediateThread:
        def __init__(self, target, args, daemon):
            self.target, self.args = target, args
        def start(self):
            self.target(*self.args)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_notify, 'server_mines_webhook', lambda: 'https://example.invalid/hook')
    monkeypatch.setattr(threading, 'Thread', ImmediateThread)
    monkeypatch.setattr(reports, '_post', lambda url, payload: sent.append(payload))
    promotions.store.db.execute('CREATE TABLE funcs(addr TEXT,score INTEGER)')
    promotions.store.db.execute("INSERT INTO funcs VALUES('00500000',100)")
    promotions.store.db.commit()
    before = promotions.store.db.execute('SELECT * FROM funcs').fetchall()
    result = integration_notify.record_partials(promotions, 'alice', body)
    assert result == dict(recorded=1, local_only=True, exact_credits=0)
    assert integration_notify.record_partials(promotions, 'alice', body)['recorded'] == 0
    assert len(sent) == 1
    text = str(sent[0])
    assert '70.000% → 80.000%' in text and 'frame improved' in text
    assert 'not server-verified exacts' in text and '0 exact credits' in text
    assert sent[0]['allowed_mentions'] == {'parse': []}
    assert promotions.store.db.execute('SELECT * FROM funcs').fetchall() == before
    assert promotions.store.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_credit').fetchone()[0] == 0
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='score'):
        integration_notify.record_partials(promotions, 'alice', dict(body, partials=[dict(row, score=float('nan'))]))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='target'):
        integration_notify.record_partials(promotions, 'alice', dict(body, partials=[dict(row, addr='ffffffff')]))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='hashes'):
        integration_notify.record_partials(promotions, 'alice', dict(body, partials=[dict(row, object_sha256='bad')]))

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode',['absolute','relative','drive','unicode-case'])
def test_input_fingerprint_fast_labels_preserve_original_digest(tmp_path, mode):
    import hashlib
    if mode == 'unicode-case' and os.name != 'nt':
        pytest.skip('Windows Unicode case alias')
    root = (Path('relative-root') if mode == 'relative' else Path(tmp_path.anchor) if mode == 'drive'
            else Path('C:/native/İ') if mode == 'unicode-case' else tmp_path/'root')
    paths = [root,root/'file.cpp',root/'nested/header.h',root/'../sibling/file.cpp',
             root.parent/(root.name+'-other')/'same-prefix.h',tmp_path/'outside/header.h']
    if mode == 'unicode-case':
        paths.append(Path('c:/NATIVE/i\u0307/Header.h'))
    contents = {path:hashlib.sha256(str(path).encode()).digest() for path in paths}
    before = hashlib.sha256(b'native-inputs-v2\0')
    for path in sorted(set(paths),key=str):
        label = path.relative_to(root).as_posix() if path.is_relative_to(root) else str(path)
        before.update(label.encode()+b'\0'+contents[path])
    for name in ('INCLUDE','LIB','LIBPATH','CL','_CL_','PATH','WINEPREFIX','ROC_CL','ROC_WINSDK','ROC_ATLMFC'):
        before.update(name.encode()+b'='+os.environ.get(name,'').encode())
    assert integration_verify.digest_paths(root,paths,contents) == before.hexdigest()

@pytest.mark.parametrize('committed', [False, True])
def test_gateway_submission_recovers_exact_saved_intent_without_duplicate(promotions, committed):
    from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
    directory = promotions.root / 'work/integration-client'
    claims = promotions.claim('alice', 'pc')['claims']
    body = upload(claims)
    original_generator = promotions.generator.read_bytes()
    folder = directory / 'requests' / integration.submission_key(body)
    calls = []
    class Api:
        fail = True
        def call(self, path, payload=None):
            if payload is None:
                query = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(urlparse(path).query).items()}
                return promotions.status(request=query['request'], user=query['user'], include_claims=True)
            calls.append(payload)
            if self.fail:
                self.fail = False
                if committed:
                    promotions.submit('alice', payload)
                raise worker.ApiFailure('server_fail', 'gateway timeout')
            return promotions.submit('alice', payload)
    api = Api()
    if committed:
        result = integration.submit_intent(api, directory, folder, body, promotions.generator, promotions.generator,
                                           {'applied_paths': ['App/Test.cpp']})
    else:
        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):
            integration.submit_intent(api, directory, folder, body, promotions.generator, promotions.generator,
                                      {'applied_paths': ['App/Test.cpp']})
        assert json.loads((folder / 'submission.json').read_text()) == body
        promotions.generator.write_bytes(b'# unrelated local edits after gateway failure\n')
        result = integration.resume_pending(api, directory, 'alice')[0]
    assert result['state'] == 'queued'
    assert promotions.store.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_jobs').fetchone()[0] == 1
    assert all(item == body for item in calls)
    assert json.loads((directory / 'claims' / claims[0]['id'] / 'job.json').read_text())['id'] == result['id']
    assert (directory / 'jobs' / result['id'] / 'submitted-generator.py').read_bytes() == original_generator
    if not committed:
        assert promotions.generator.read_bytes() == b'# unrelated local edits after gateway failure\n'
    assert not integration.resume_pending(api, directory, 'alice')

        promotions.store, "test-password", {"2008-06"}, integration=promotions))

            for _ in range(500):

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode',['absolute','relative','drive','unicode-case'])
def test_input_fingerprint_fast_labels_preserve_original_digest(tmp_path, mode):
    import hashlib
    if mode == 'unicode-case' and os.name != 'nt':
        pytest.skip('Windows Unicode case alias')
    root = (Path('relative-root') if mode == 'relative' else Path(tmp_path.anchor) if mode == 'drive'
            else Path('C:/native/İ') if mode == 'unicode-case' else tmp_path/'root')
    paths = [root,root/'file.cpp',root/'nested/header.h',root/'../sibling/file.cpp',
             root.parent/(root.name+'-other')/'same-prefix.h',tmp_path/'outside/header.h']
    if mode == 'unicode-case':
        paths.append(Path('c:/NATIVE/i\u0307/Header.h'))
    contents = {path:hashlib.sha256(str(path).encode()).digest() for path in paths}
    before = hashlib.sha256(b'native-inputs-v2\0')
    for path in sorted(set(paths),key=str):
        label = path.relative_to(root).as_posix() if path.is_relative_to(root) else str(path)
        before.update(label.encode()+b'\0'+contents[path])
    for name in ('INCLUDE','LIB','LIBPATH','CL','_CL_','PATH','WINEPREFIX','ROC_CL','ROC_WINSDK','ROC_ATLMFC'):
        before.update(name.encode()+b'='+os.environ.get(name,'').encode())
    assert integration_verify.digest_paths(root,paths,contents) == before.hexdigest()

@pytest.mark.parametrize('committed', [False, True])
def test_gateway_submission_recovers_exact_saved_intent_without_duplicate(promotions, committed):
    from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
    directory = promotions.root / 'work/integration-client'
    claims = promotions.claim('alice', 'pc')['claims']
    body = upload(claims)
    original_generator = promotions.generator.read_bytes()
    folder = directory / 'requests' / integration.submission_key(body)
    calls = []
    class Api:
        fail = True
        def call(self, path, payload=None):
            if payload is None:
                query = {k: v[0] for k, v in parse_qs(urlparse(path).query).items()}
                return promotions.status(request=query['request'], user=query['user'], include_claims=True)
            calls.append(payload)
            if self.fail:
                self.fail = False
                if committed:
                    promotions.submit('alice', payload)
                raise worker.ApiFailure('server_fail', 'gateway timeout')
            return promotions.submit('alice', payload)
    api = Api()
    if committed:
        result = integration.submit_intent(api, directory, folder, body, promotions.generator, promotions.generator,
                                           {'applied_paths': ['App/Test.cpp']})
    else:
        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):
            integration.submit_intent(api, directory, folder, body, promotions.generator, promotions.generator,
                                      {'applied_paths': ['App/Test.cpp']})
        assert json.loads((folder / 'submission.json').read_text()) == body
        promotions.generator.write_bytes(b'# unrelated local edits after gateway failure\n')
        result = integration.resume_pending(api, directory, 'alice')[0]
    assert result['state'] == 'queued'
    assert promotions.store.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_jobs').fetchone()[0] == 1
    assert all(item == body for item in calls)
    assert json.loads((directory / 'claims' / claims[0]['id'] / 'job.json').read_text())['id'] == result['id']
    assert (directory / 'jobs' / result['id'] / 'submitted-generator.py').read_bytes() == original_generator
    if not committed:
        assert promotions.generator.read_bytes() == b'# unrelated local edits after gateway failure\n'
    assert not integration.resume_pending(api, directory, 'alice')

def test_two_pcs_use_http_without_shared_client_files(promotions):
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), server.make_handler(
        promotions.store, "test-password", {"2008-06"}, integration=promotions))
    httpd.daemon_threads = True
    thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:%d" % httpd.server_port
    try:
        alice, bob = worker.Api(url, None), worker.Api(url, None)
        a = alice.call("/v1/integration/claim", {"user": "alice", "worker": "laptop", "count": 1})["claims"]
        b = bob.call("/v1/integration/claim", {"user": "bob", "worker": "desktop", "count": 1})["claims"]
        assert a[0]["unit"] != b[0]["unit"]
        queued = alice.call("/v1/integration/submit", upload(a))
        assert queued["state"] == "queued"
        prioritized = alice.call("/v1/integration/force-queue", {"user": "alice", "id": queued["id"]})
        assert prioritized["priority"] == "next" and prioritized["waits_for_active"]
        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):
            bob.call("/v1/integration/force-queue", {"user": "bob", "id": queued["id"]})
        wrong_token = worker.Api(url, "wrong-token")
        try:
            assert wrong_token.call("/v1/integration/force-queue", {"user": "alice", "id": queued["id"]})["priority"] == "next"
        finally:
            wrong_token.close()
        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):
            bob.call("/v1/integration/submit", upload(a, "bob"))
        with pytest.raises(worker.ApiFailure):
            alice.call("/v1/integration/finish", {"user": "alice", "accepted": True})

    finally:
        httpd.shutdown()
        httpd.server_close()

def test_verify_build_runs_header_gates_beside_the_build(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    built, order = threading.Event(), []

    def run(root, args, log):
        name = log.name
        order.append((name, built.is_set()))
        if name == "integration-build.log":
            # the header gates must already be running: the build waits for them instead of racing
            for _ in range(500):
                if {"integration-size.log", "integration-base.log"} <= {n for n, _ in order}:
                    break
                threading.Event().wait(0.01)
            built.set()

    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, "run", run)
    monkeypatch.setattr(integration_verify, "collect", lambda root: "ok")
    assert integration_verify.verify_build(tmp_path, lambda phase: None) == "ok"
    seen = dict(order)
    assert order[0][0] == "integration-overlay.log"
    assert seen["integration-size.log"] is False and seen["integration-base.log"] is False
    assert seen["integration-milestones.log"] is True and seen["integration-status.log"] is True

def test_parallel_early_reservations_exclude_duplicate_agent_work(promotions):

    class Api:
        def call(self,path,body):
            if path.endswith('/claim'):
                return promotions.claim(body['user'],body['worker'],unit=body['unit'])

import struct
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from roc import libs, match


def test_library_metadata_comments_share_object_cache_but_settings_and_bodies_do_not(monkeypatch):
    from functools import lru_cache
    calls = []
    body = ["int vendor() { return 1; }"]
    monkeypatch.setattr(match.clients, "load", lambda: {"test": {"compiler_build": 21022}})
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "unit", lambda *args: body[0])
    @lru_cache(None)
    def compile_cached(text, flags, build, c_lang):
        calls.append((text, flags, build, c_lang))
        return str(len(calls)).encode()
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, "_compile", compile_cached)
    first = "// from server: 99% by first\n// roc-lib: test vendor.cpp\n"
    second = "// address 00401040\n// roc-lib: test vendor.cpp\n"
    assert match.compile_text("test", first) == match.compile_text("test", second)
    assert len(calls) == 1 and calls[0][0] == body[0]
    match.compile_text("test", second, flags="/O1")
    assert len(calls) == 2 and calls[-1][1] == "/O1"
    body[0] = "int vendor() { return 2; }"
    match.compile_text("test", first)
    assert len(calls) == 3 and calls[-1][0] == body[0]


def test_library_real_prelude_and_comment_continuation_are_preserved(monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(match.clients, "load", lambda: {"test": {"compiler_build": 21022}})
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "unit", lambda *args: "int vendor;")
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, "_compile", lambda *args: calls.append(args) or b"obj")
    prelude = "// roc-lib: test vendor.cpp\nint local_value;\n"
    continuation = "// roc-lib: test vendor.cpp\n// folder\\\n"
    match.compile_text("test", prelude)
    match.compile_text("test", continuation)
    assert calls[0][0] == prelude + "\nint vendor;"
    assert calls[1][0] == continuation + "\nint vendor;"


def test_raw_library_prelude_include_failure_explains_managed_units(monkeypatch):
    import pytest
    monkeypatch.setattr(match.clients, "load", lambda: {"test": {"compiler_build": 21022}})
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "unit", lambda *args: "int vendor;")
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, "_cacheable", lambda text: False)
    def fail(*args):
        raise match.CompileError("source(1): fatal error C1083: Cannot open include file: G3D/ReferenceCount.h")
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, "_compile_uncached", fail)
    with pytest.raises(match.CompileError) as error:
        match.compile_text("test", "// roc-lib: test vendor.cpp\n#include <G3D/ReferenceCount.h>\n")
    assert "C1083" in str(error.value) and "libs.add_unit" in str(error.value)
    assert "recipe include paths" in str(error.value)


def test_library_patched_copy_uses_acl_safe_compile_directory(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    source = tmp_path / "source"
    source.mkdir()
    (source / "unit.cpp").write_text("old")
    safe = tmp_path / "safe"
    used = []

    @contextmanager
    def compile_directory():
        safe.mkdir()
        used.append(True)
        yield safe

    monkeypatch.setitem(libs.RECIPES, "test", {"patches": {"unit.cpp": [["old", "new"]]}})
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "fetch", lambda name: source)
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, "compile_directory", compile_directory)
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "preprocess", lambda build, path, include, defines, deps: Path(path).read_text())
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "ROOT", tmp_path)
    assert "new" in libs.unit("test", "unit.cpp", 21022)
    assert used


def test_data_ref_starts_at_relocation_addend():
    # .text: mov eax, [table+4]  (addend 4 stored in the instruction); .data: table = 8 bytes.
    code = b"\xa1\x04\x00\x00\x00\xc3"
    data = b"AAAABBBB"
    text_ptr = 20 + 2 * 40
    data_ptr = text_ptr + len(code)
    reloc_ptr = data_ptr + len(data)
    sym_ptr = reloc_ptr + 10
    header = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", 0x14c, 2, 0, sym_ptr, 2, 0, 0)
    text = struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".text", 0, 0, len(code), text_ptr, reloc_ptr, 0, 1, 0, 0x60000020)
    sec_data = struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".data", 0, 0, len(data), data_ptr, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xC0000040)
    reloc = struct.pack("<IIH", 1, 1, 6)  # DIR32 at offset 1 -> symbol 1 (table)
    syms = (struct.pack("<8sIhHBB", b"_f", 0, 1, 0x20, 2, 0)
            + struct.pack("<8sIhHBB", b"_table", 0, 2, 0, 3, 0))
    obj = header + text + sec_data + code + data + reloc + syms + struct.pack("<I", 4)
    assert match.coff_data_refs(obj, "_f") == [(1, b"BBBB", [])]


def test_file_literal_uses_original_build_spelling():
    recipe = {"file_names": {"G3Dcpp\\Stopwatch.cpp": ".\\g3dcpp\\Stopwatch.cpp",
                             "*": lambda p: ".\\" + p.replace("GLG3Dcpp\\", "glg3dcpp\\")}}
    src = "C:\\libs\\g3d\\GLG3Dcpp\\Shader.cpp"

    assert libs._file_literal(recipe, src, "GLG3Dcpp/Shader.cpp", body) == \
        'assert(".\\\\glg3dcpp\\\\Shader.cpp");'
    stop = 'f("C:\\\\libs\\\\g3d\\\\G3Dcpp\\\\Stopwatch.cpp");'
    assert libs._file_literal(recipe, "C:\\libs\\g3d\\G3Dcpp\\Stopwatch.cpp", "G3Dcpp/Stopwatch.cpp", stop) == \
        'f(".\\\\g3dcpp\\\\Stopwatch.cpp");'
    assert libs._file_literal({}, src, "x.cpp", body) == body


def test_expanded_units_bound_memory_reload_disk_and_invalidate_headers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    from roc import libs
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "_UNITS", {})
    header = tmp_path / "header.h"
    header.write_text("header1")
    paths = []
    for index in range(33):
        path = tmp_path / (str(index) + ".i")
        path.write_text("expanded" + str(index))
        libs._write_deps(path, "recipe", [header])
        assert libs._cached_unit(path, "recipe") == "expanded" + str(index)
        paths.append(path)
    assert len(libs._UNITS) == 32 and str(paths[0]) not in libs._UNITS
    original_read = Path.read_text
    reads = []
    def read(path, *args, **kwargs):
        if path.suffix == ".i": reads.append(path)
        return original_read(path, *args, **kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_text", read)
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "recipe") == "expanded0"
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "recipe") == "expanded0"
    assert reads == [paths[0]] and len(libs._UNITS) == 32
    previous = header.stat()
    header.write_text("header2")
    os.utime(header, ns=(previous.st_atime_ns, previous.st_mtime_ns + 10000000))
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "recipe") is None
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "changed-recipe") is None


def test_data_relocation_range_keeps_both_boundaries_exact(monkeypatch):
    base = 0x400000
    image = b'xxxxABCDWXYZyyyy'
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_image', lambda _: (base, image))
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_base_relocs', lambda _: frozenset({base + 3, base + 4, base + 12}))
    code = (base + 4).to_bytes(4, 'little')
    # Relocation at start is masked; relocation at end must not extend the mask.
    assert match.data_check('client', '00400000', code, [(0, b'----WXYZ', [])])[1] == []
    assert match.data_check('client', '00400000', code, [(0, b'----FAIL', [])])[1]

def test_data_ref_starts_at_relocation_addend():
    # .text: mov eax, [table+4]  (addend 4 stored in the instruction); .data: table = 8 bytes.
    code = b"\xa1\x04\x00\x00\x00\xc3"
    data = b"AAAABBBB"
    text_ptr = 20 + 2 * 40
    data_ptr = text_ptr + len(code)
    reloc_ptr = data_ptr + len(data)
    sym_ptr = reloc_ptr + 10
    header = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", 0x14c, 2, 0, sym_ptr, 2, 0, 0)
    text = struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".text", 0, 0, len(code), text_ptr, reloc_ptr, 0, 1, 0, 0x60000020)
    sec_data = struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".data", 0, 0, len(data), data_ptr, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xC0000040)
    reloc = struct.pack("<IIH", 1, 1, 6)  # DIR32 at offset 1 -> symbol 1 (table)
    syms = (struct.pack("<8sIhHBB", b"_f", 0, 1, 0x20, 2, 0)
            + struct.pack("<8sIhHBB", b"_table", 0, 2, 0, 3, 0))
    obj = header + text + sec_data + code + data + reloc + syms + struct.pack("<I", 4)
    assert match.coff_data_refs(obj, "_f") == [(1, b"BBBB", [])]

def test_expanded_units_bound_memory_reload_disk_and_invalidate_headers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    from roc import libs
    monkeypatch.setattr(libs, "_UNITS", {})
    header = tmp_path / "header.h"
    header.write_text("header1")
    paths = []
    for index in range(33):
        path = tmp_path / (str(index) + ".i")
        path.write_text("expanded" + str(index))
        libs._write_deps(path, "recipe", [header])
        assert libs._cached_unit(path, "recipe") == "expanded" + str(index)
        paths.append(path)
    assert len(libs._UNITS) == 32 and str(paths[0]) not in libs._UNITS
    original_read = Path.read_text
    reads = []
    def read(path, *args, **kwargs):
        if path.suffix == ".i": reads.append(path)
        return original_read(path, *args, **kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_text", read)
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "recipe") == "expanded0"
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "recipe") == "expanded0"
    assert reads == [paths[0]] and len(libs._UNITS) == 32
    previous = header.stat()
    header.write_text("header2")
    os.utime(header, ns=(previous.st_atime_ns, previous.st_mtime_ns + 10000000))
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "recipe") is None
    assert libs._cached_unit(paths[0], "changed-recipe") is None


def test_data_relocation_range_keeps_both_boundaries_exact(monkeypatch):
    base = 0x400000
    image = b'xxxxABCDWXYZyyyy'
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_image', lambda _: (base, image))
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_base_relocs', lambda _: frozenset({base + 3, base + 4, base + 12}))
    code = (base + 4).to_bytes(4, 'little')
    # Relocation at start is masked; relocation at end must not extend the mask.
    assert match.data_check('client', '00400000', code, [(0, b'----WXYZ', [])])[1] == []
    assert match.data_check('client', '00400000', code, [(0, b'----FAIL', [])])[1]

import copy

import pytest

from roc import library_verify


def sample():
    before = dict(module='OgreNativeHeaders', linked=True, test_exit=0, unresolved=[], owned_addrs=['00000001'])
    after = dict(module='OgreNativeHeaders', linked=True, test_exit=0, unresolved=[],
                 owned_addrs=['00000001', '00000002', '00000003'])
    proofs = [dict(target=a, code_exact_in_executable=True,
                   linked_proofs=[dict(owner='linked:real.obj', code_exact=True,
                                       object_code_data_exact=True)])
              for a in ['00000002', '00000003']]
    return before, after, {'client-headers': {}}, proofs


def test_library_gate_counts_only_claimed_globally_new_addresses():
    before, after, errors, proofs = sample()
    result = library_verify.validate('ogre-native-headers', before, after, errors, proofs,
                                     ['00000002', '00000003'], {'00000002'})
    assert result['new_distinct'] == ['00000003']
    assert result['added'] == ['00000002', '00000003']


def test_library_gate_rejects_unapproved_profile_and_module():
    before, after, errors, proofs = sample()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Unknown'):
        library_verify.validate('user-supplied', before, after, errors, proofs, ['00000002'], set())
    after['module'] = 'RbxgsApp'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='module'):
        library_verify.validate('ogre-native-headers', before, after, errors, proofs, ['00000002'], set())


@pytest.mark.parametrize('failure', ['link', 'runtime', 'unresolved', 'compile', 'loss',
                                     'baseline', 'missing_layer', 'unclaimed', 'missing_proof', 'object', 'executable', 'owner'])
def test_library_gate_rejects_incomplete_evidence(failure):
    before, after, errors, proofs = copy.deepcopy(sample())
    claimed = ['00000002']
    if failure == 'link': after['linked'] = False
    if failure == 'runtime': after['test_exit'] = 1
    if failure == 'unresolved': after['unresolved'] = ['missing']
    if failure == 'compile': errors['client-headers'] = {'file.cpp': 'error'}
    if failure == 'baseline': before['test_exit'] = 1
    if failure == 'missing_layer': errors.clear()
    if failure == 'loss': after['owned_addrs'].remove('00000001')
    if failure == 'unclaimed': claimed = ['00000001']
    if failure == 'missing_proof': proofs.pop()
    if failure == 'object': proofs[0]['linked_proofs'][0]['object_code_data_exact'] = False
    if failure == 'executable': proofs[0]['code_exact_in_executable'] = False
    if failure == 'owner': proofs[0]['linked_proofs'][0]['owner'] = 'other.obj'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        library_verify.validate('ogre-native-headers', before, after, errors, proofs, claimed, set())

"""Linux support: the Wine platform layer and the non-Windows install paths.

These tests run on any OS: they patch roc.setup.WINDOWS to False rather than
depending on the host, so the Linux branches are exercised on Windows CI too.
"""
import os
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def test_refresh_path_is_a_noop_off_windows():
    from roc import setup
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch.dict("os.environ", {"PATH": "/usr/bin"}):
        assert setup.refresh_path() == "/usr/bin"


def test_wine_paths_are_z_drive_windows_paths():
    from roc import setup
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False):
        assert setup.to_wine_path("/tmp/a b/f.cpp") == "z:\\tmp\\a b\\f.cpp"
        assert setup.cl_path("/tmp/f.cpp") == "z:\\tmp\\f.cpp"
        with patch.dict("os.environ", {"ROC_WINE_DRIVE": "d:"}):
            assert setup.to_wine_path("/src/x.cpp") == "d:\\src\\x.cpp"


def test_cl_command_uses_wine_on_linux():
    from roc import setup
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), \
         patch("roc.setup.wine_exe", return_value="/usr/bin/wine"):
        assert setup.cl_command("/tools/vc/VC/bin/cl.exe") == ["/usr/bin/wine", "/tools/vc/VC/bin/cl.exe"]
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch("roc.setup.wine_exe", return_value=None):
        try:
            setup.cl_command("/tools/vc/VC/bin/cl.exe")
            assert False, "missing Wine must be an error, not a silent fallback"
        except SystemExit as error:
            assert "Wine" in str(error)
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", True):
        assert setup.cl_command("/tools/vc/VC/bin/cl.exe") == ["/tools/vc/VC/bin/cl.exe"]


def test_compilers_returns_empty_without_wine():

    setup.compilers.cache_clear()
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch("roc.setup.wine_exe", return_value=None):
        assert setup.compilers() == {}
    setup.compilers.cache_clear()


def test_cl_env_under_wine_uses_windows_include_and_winepath(tmp_path):
    from roc import setup
    if os.name == "nt":
        return  # Wine paths only exist on a Unix host; tmp paths here are C:\-shaped
    cl = tmp_path / "VC" / "bin" / "cl.exe"
    (tmp_path / "VC" / "include").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "Common7" / "IDE").mkdir(parents=True)
    setup._cached_cl_env.cache_clear()
    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False):
        env = setup.cl_env(cl)
    assert env["WINEPATH"].startswith("z:\\")
    assert ";" in env["WINEPATH"], "Wine needs Windows-style PATH separators"
    assert env["INCLUDE"] == setup.to_wine_path(tmp_path / "VC" / "include")
    assert env["WINEPREFIX"]
    setup._cached_cl_env.cache_clear()

    prefix.mkdir()

    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), \
         patch("roc.setup.WINE_PREFIX", prefix), \
         patch("roc.setup.wine_exe", return_value="/usr/bin/wine"), \

        assert not run.called, "an existing prefix must not be re-created"

         patch("roc.setup.ensure_packages"):

         patch("roc.setup.find_exe", return_value="/usr/bin/ollama"), \
         patch("roc.setup.ensure_ollama", return_value=["qwen2.5-coder:14b"]), \

    assert not run.called, "declining must not pull anything"


def test_cloudflared_url_matches_the_platform():
    from roc import setup
    with patch("roc.setup.platform.machine", return_value="x86_64"):
        with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", True):
            assert setup.cloudflared_url().endswith("windows-amd64.exe")
        with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch("roc.setup.sys.platform", "linux"):
            assert setup.cloudflared_url().endswith("linux-amd64")
        with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch("roc.setup.sys.platform", "linux"), \
             patch("roc.setup.platform.machine", return_value="aarch64"):
            assert setup.cloudflared_url().endswith("linux-arm64")
        with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch("roc.setup.sys.platform", "linux"), \
             patch("roc.setup.platform.machine", return_value="armv7l"):
            assert setup.cloudflared_url().endswith("linux-arm"), "32-bit Pi must not get amd64"
        with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), patch("roc.setup.sys.platform", "darwin"):
            assert setup.cloudflared_url() is None, "darwin ships a .tgz we do not unpack"


def test_has_compiler_detects_partial_extraction(tmp_path):
    from roc import setup
    (tmp_path / "VC" / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)

def test_msi_admin_extract_prefers_wine_on_linux(tmp_path):
    from roc import setup
    target = tmp_path / "out"

    def fake_run(cmd, **kwargs):
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (target / "cl.exe").write_bytes(b"MZ")
        class Done:
            returncode = 0
            stdout = stderr = ""
        return Done()

    with patch("roc.setup.WINDOWS", False), \
         patch("roc.setup.ensure_wine_prefix", return_value=True), \
         patch("roc.setup.wine_exe", return_value="/usr/bin/wine"), \
         patch("roc.setup.subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_run) as run:
        setup.msi_admin_extract(tmp_path / "x.msi", target)
    assert run.call_args.args[0][:3] == ["/usr/bin/wine", "msiexec", "/a"]


def test_copy_from_iso_extracts_one_file(tmp_path):
    from roc import setup
    iso = tmp_path / "dvd.iso"
    iso.write_bytes(b"iso")
    dest = tmp_path / "out" / "Ixpvc.exe"

    def fake_run(cmd, **kwargs):
        out = next((Path(part[2:]) for part in cmd if isinstance(part, str) and part.startswith("-o")), None)
        if out:
            found = out / "VCExpress" / "Ixpvc.exe"
            found.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            found.write_bytes(b"MZ")

        class Done:
            returncode = 0
        return Done()

    with patch("roc.setup.shutil.which", side_effect=lambda name: "/usr/bin/7z" if name == "7z" else None), \
         patch("roc.setup.subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_run):
        setup.copy_from_iso(iso, r"VCExpress\Ixpvc.exe", dest)
    assert dest.read_bytes() == b"MZ"


def test_wine_exe_honors_roc_wine_override():
    from roc import setup
    with patch.dict("os.environ", {"ROC_WINE": "/opt/box86-wine"}):
        assert setup.wine_exe() == "/opt/box86-wine"
    with patch.dict("os.environ", {"ROC_WINE": ""}), \
         patch("roc.setup.shutil.which", return_value="/usr/bin/wine"):
        assert setup.wine_exe() == "/usr/bin/wine"


def test_msi_string_pool_decodes_ids():
    from roc import setup
    # entry 0 is the codepage; later entries are (length, refcount) pairs, with an
    # empty entry still consuming a string id.
    pool = (struct.pack("<HH", 0, 0) + struct.pack("<HH", 4, 1) + struct.pack("<HH", 5, 1)
            + struct.pack("<HH", 0, 0) + struct.pack("<HH", 3, 1))
    strings, strref = setup._msi_strings(pool, b"NameTableabc")
    assert strref == 2
    assert strings[1] == "Name" and strings[2] == "Table"
    assert 3 not in strings and strings[4] == "abc"


def test_msi_table_rows_are_column_major():
    from roc import setup
    schema = setup.MSI_LAYOUT_TABLES["Directory"]  # three 2-byte string columns
    strings = {0: "", 1: "root", 2: "child", 3: "PARENT", 4: "sub", 5: "x"}
    raw = b"".join(struct.pack("<H", v) for v in [1, 2, 0, 3, 4, 5])
    rows = setup._msi_table_rows(raw, schema, strings, 2)
    assert rows[0] == {"Directory": "root", "Directory_Parent": "", "DefaultDir": "sub"}
    assert rows[1] == {"Directory": "child", "Directory_Parent": "PARENT", "DefaultDir": "x"}


def test_handoff_launch_command_off_windows():
    from roc import link
    with patch("roc.link.os.name", "posix"):
        command = link.launch_command()
    assert command[0] == sys.executable
    assert command[1].endswith("roc.py") and command[2] == "launch"


def test_link_install_is_a_noop_off_windows(capsys):
    from roc import link
    with patch("roc.link.os.name", "posix"):
        assert link.install() is False
        assert link.installed() is False
    assert "Windows-only" in capsys.readouterr().out

def test_msi_admin_extract_prefers_wine_on_linux(tmp_path):
    from roc import setup
    target = tmp_path / "out"

    def fake_run(cmd, **kwargs):
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (target / "cl.exe").write_bytes(b"MZ")
        class Done:
            returncode = 0
            stdout = stderr = ""
        return Done()

         patch("roc.setup.ensure_wine_prefix", return_value=True), \

def test_msi_string_pool_decodes_ids():
    from roc import setup
    # entry 0 is the codepage; later entries are (length, refcount) pairs, with an
    # empty entry still consuming a string id.
    pool = (struct.pack("<HH", 0, 0) + struct.pack("<HH", 4, 1) + struct.pack("<HH", 5, 1)
            + struct.pack("<HH", 0, 0) + struct.pack("<HH", 3, 1))
    strings, strref = setup._msi_strings(pool, b"NameTableabc")
    assert strref == 2
    assert strings[1] == "Name" and strings[2] == "Table"
    assert 3 not in strings and strings[4] == "abc"


def test_msi_table_rows_are_column_major():
    from roc import setup
    schema = setup.MSI_LAYOUT_TABLES["Directory"]  # three 2-byte string columns
    strings = {0: "", 1: "root", 2: "child", 3: "PARENT", 4: "sub", 5: "x"}
    raw = b"".join(struct.pack("<H", v) for v in [1, 2, 0, 3, 4, 5])
    rows = setup._msi_table_rows(raw, schema, strings, 2)
    assert rows[0] == {"Directory": "root", "Directory_Parent": "", "DefaultDir": "sub"}
    assert rows[1] == {"Directory": "child", "Directory_Parent": "PARENT", "DefaultDir": "x"}


def test_msi_schemas_take_widths_from_the_columns_table():
    from roc import setup
    # VS2008 stores the File table's numeric columns as i4 (including Sequence);
    # hardcoding i2 made the row size wrong and the 7z path silently fell back.
    rows = [
        {"Table": "File", "Number": 1, "Name": "File", "Type": 0x2D48},        # string
        {"Table": "File", "Number": 4, "Name": "FileSize", "Type": 0x0104},    # i4
        {"Table": "File", "Number": 7, "Name": "Attributes", "Type": 0x1502},  # i2
        {"Table": "File", "Number": 8, "Name": "Sequence", "Type": 0x0104},    # i4
        {"Table": "Directory", "Number": 1, "Name": "Directory", "Type": 0x2D48},
    ]
    schemas = setup._msi_schemas(rows, ["File", "Directory"])
    assert schemas["File"] == [("File", "s"), ("FileSize", "i4"),
                               ("Attributes", "i2"), ("Sequence", "i4")]
    assert schemas["Directory"] == [("Directory", "s")]


def test_msi_table_ignores_msiinfo_header_rows(tmp_path):
    from roc import setup
    # `msiinfo export` writes the column names, the column types, then the table
    # name plus its primary keys before the data. Those header lines have fewer
    # fields than a row and used to be read as data (KeyError: 'DefaultDir').
    out = ("Directory\tDirectory_Parent\tDefaultDir\r\n"
           "s72\ts72\tl255\r\n"
           "Directory\tDirectory\r\n"
           "root\t\tSourceDir\r\n"
           "child\troot\tsub\r\n")

    class Done:
        returncode = 0
        stdout = out
        stderr = ""

    with patch("roc.setup.subprocess.run", return_value=Done()):
        rows = setup.msi_table(tmp_path / "x.msi", "Directory")
    assert rows == [
        {"Directory": "root", "Directory_Parent": "", "DefaultDir": "SourceDir"},
        {"Directory": "child", "Directory_Parent": "root", "DefaultDir": "sub"},
    ]

    from roc import link
    with patch("roc.link.os.name", "posix"):

    assert command[0] == sys.executable
    assert command[1].endswith("roc.py") and command[2] == "launch"

    from roc import link
    with patch("roc.link.os.name", "posix"):
        assert link.install() is False
        assert link.installed() is False
    assert "Windows-only" in capsys.readouterr().out

"""Client-isolated Discord digests and explicit LLM submission credit."""
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from roc import reports, server, worker


@pytest.mark.parametrize("automatic", [False, True])
def test_mixed_clients_send_separate_messages(monkeypatch, automatic):
    store = Mock()
    store.display_progress.side_effect = lambda client: (8, 10, 80, 100) if client == "2008-06" else (2, 20, 20, 200)
    store.digest_progress.return_value = (20, 20, 40, 100)
    store.match_rate.return_value = 1 / 3600
    store.match_byte_rate.return_value = 10 / 3600
    store.user_points.return_value = 100
    sent = []

    class ImmediateThread:
        def __init__(self, target, args, daemon):
            self.target, self.args = target, args

        def start(self):
            self.target(*self.args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(reports.threading, "Thread", ImmediateThread)
    monkeypatch.setattr(reports, "_post", lambda url, payload: sent.append(payload))
    log = reports.MineLog("unused", store, server=automatic)
    events = [dict(job=dict(client=client, addr=addr, unit="unit", size=10), user=user,
                   worker=user, model=model, score=score, points=10)
              for client, addr, user, model, score in [
                  ("2008-06", "00800001", "colin", "gpt-6.1-sol", 100),
                  ("2012-06", "01200001", "intel", "claude-opus", 80),
                  ("2008-06", "00800002", "intel", "claude-opus", 75)]]
    log._send(events)
    assert len(sent) == 2
    first, second = [payload["embeds"][0] for payload in sent]
    assert "2008-06 Client" in first["description"] and "8 / 10 matched" in first["description"]
    assert "2012-06 Client" in second["description"] and "2 / 20 matched" in second["description"]
    assert "00800001" in str(first) and "00800002" in str(first) and "01200001" not in str(first)
    assert "01200001" in str(second) and "008000" not in str(second) and "colin" not in str(second)
    assert first["fields"][-1]["name"] == ("🔧 Functions" if automatic else "🔧 Models")
    assert "gpt-6.1-sol" in str(first) and "gpt-6.1-sol" not in str(second)
    assert "negative_squared_cross_mark" not in str(sent) and "❎" not in str(sent)
    assert ":yellow_square:" in first["description"] and "🟨 partial" in first["description"]
    assert first["fields"][1]["name"] == "🟡 Partially Matched"
    assert "🟡" in first["fields"][1]["value"]
    assert first["fields"][2]["value"] == "**1 functions/hr** · **10 B/hr** *(last 6h)* · byte ETA 2h 0m"
    assert second["fields"][2]["value"].endswith("byte ETA 18h 0m")
    if not automatic:
        assert first["fields"][3]["value"] == "**colin** · 100 pts *(+10)*\n**intel** · 100 pts *(+10)*"
        assert "workers in batch" not in str(first) and "worker in batch" not in str(first)
    assert store.match_rate.call_args_list[0].args == ("2008-06", 21600)
    assert store.match_rate.call_args_list[1].args == ("2012-06", 21600)
    assert store.match_byte_rate.call_args_list[0].args == ("2008-06", 21600)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="one client"):
        log.digest(events)


def test_rate_uses_six_hours_and_target_bytes(monkeypatch):
    store = server.Store(":memory:", 1)
    monkeypatch.setattr(server.time, "time", lambda: 30000)
    try:
        store.db.executemany("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)", [
            (26400, "2008-06", "a", "user", 50, 100),
            (12000, "2008-06", "b", "user", 0, 100),
            (4800, "2008-06", "old", "user", 0, 100),
            (29000, "2008-06", "c", "user", 0, 70),
            (29000, "2012-06", "a", "user", 0, 100)])
        store.db.executemany("INSERT INTO funcs(client,addr,size) VALUES(?,?,?)", [
            ("2008-06", "a", 60), ("2008-06", "b", 540),
            ("2008-06", "old", 9000), ("2008-06", "c", 9000), ("2012-06", "a", 6000)])
        assert store.match_rate("2008-06", reports.RATE_WINDOW) * 3600 == pytest.approx(2 / 6)
        assert store.match_byte_rate("2008-06", reports.RATE_WINDOW) * 3600 == 100
        assert store.match_byte_rate("missing", reports.RATE_WINDOW) == 0
        store.db.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(29000,'2008-06','a','user',0,100)")
        assert store.match_byte_rate("2008-06", reports.RATE_WINDOW) * 3600 == 100
    finally:
        store.db.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit,environment,expected", [
    ("gpt-6.1-sol", "claude-opus", "gpt-6.1-sol"),
    (None, "claude-opus", "claude-opus"), (None, "", "Unknown model")])
def test_manual_submit_credits_actual_model(tmp_path, monkeypatch, explicit, environment, expected):
    source = tmp_path / "00401000.cpp"
    source.write_text("void f() {}")
    submitted = []

    class Api:
        def __init__(self, *args):
            pass

        def call(self, path, payload=None, **kwargs):
            if path.startswith("/v1/sources?"):
                return []
            submitted.append(payload)
            return dict(stored=100, improved=True, verified=True)

    monkeypatch.setenv("ROC_AGENT_MODEL", environment)
    monkeypatch.delenv("ROC_AGENT", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(worker, "Api", Api)
    monkeypatch.setattr(worker.match, "check", lambda *args: (100, None, None, None))
    logs = []
    worker.submit_files("unused", "colin", "2008-06", [source.stem], file=source, model=explicit, log=logs.append)
    assert submitted[0]["model"] == expected
    assert submitted[0]["client"] == "2008-06"
    assert "Player Mining credit" in logs[0]
    assert not hasattr(reports, "publish_yesterday")

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from roc import native_finish as finish


@pytest.fixture
def batch(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'ROOT', tmp_path)
    config = dict(model='Actual model', user='colin', before='before.json', baseline='base.json',
                  test_source='test.cpp', evidence='Actual SDK source and native instruction evidence', submit=True)
    base = dict(revision='current', overlay={})
    (tmp_path / 'before.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(module='RbxgsApp', owned_2008=1, owned_addrs=['00400000'])))
    (tmp_path / 'base.json').write_text(json.dumps(base))
    (tmp_path / 'test.cpp').write_text('int main(){return 0;}')
    overlay = tmp_path / 'overlay.json'; overlay.write_text(json.dumps({'App/test.cpp': [['', 'new source']]}))
    spec = dict(name='RbxgsApp', overlay=dict(patches='overlay.json'), layers=[], test_includes=[], test_defines='')
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'load_module', lambda *args: spec)
    report = dict(module='RbxgsApp', linked=True, test_exit=0, unresolved=[], owned_2008=2,
                  owned_addrs=['00400000', '00400010'])
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'build_module', lambda *args, **kwargs: report)
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'build_overlay', lambda *args: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'resolve_objects', lambda *args, **kwargs: dict(linked=True, exit=0))
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish, 'linked_proofs', lambda *args: [dict(target='00400010', code_exact_in_executable=True)])
    out = tmp_path / 'rebuild/2008-06/out/RbxgsApp'; out.mkdir(parents=True)
    (out / 'owned-symbols.json').write_text(json.dumps({'00400010': [dict(symbol='?native', object='Native.obj')]}))
    (out / 'linked').mkdir();(out / 'linked/Native.obj').write_bytes(b'object')
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'coff_externals', lambda data: {'?native': True})
    (tmp_path / 'rebuild/2008-06/tests').mkdir()
    manifest = tmp_path / 'rebuild/2008-06/manifests'; manifest.mkdir()
    (manifest / 'functions.json').write_text(json.dumps([dict(addr='00400010', score=100)]))
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.worker, 'load_settings', lambda: dict(server='local'))
    packets = {}
    calls = []
    def call(path, body=None):
        calls.append(path)
        if path.endswith('/base'):
            return base
        packet = body['packet']; key = finish.integration.digest(packet)
        packets.setdefault(key, packet)
        return dict(id=key, state='needs-owner-review', verified=False, credits=0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(finish.worker, 'Api', lambda *args: SimpleNamespace(call=call, close=lambda: None))
    (tmp_path / 'finish.json').write_text(json.dumps(config))
    return tmp_path, config, base, spec, report, packets, calls


def test_finish_submits_once_on_safe_rerun(batch):
    root, _, _, _, _, packets, _ = batch
    first = finish.run(root / 'finish.json', log=lambda _: None)
    second = finish.run(root / 'finish.json', log=lambda _: None)
    assert first == second
    assert len(packets) == 1
    assert first['gained'] == 1 and first['server']['verified'] is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize('failure', ['lost', 'link', 'runtime', 'proof', 'stale', 'changed', 'compile'])
def test_failure_cannot_submit_or_notify(batch, monkeypatch, failure):
    root, _, base, spec, report, packets, _ = batch
    if failure == 'lost':
        report['owned_addrs'] = ['00400010']
    elif failure == 'link':
        report['linked'] = False
    elif failure == 'runtime':
        monkeypatch.setattr(finish.rebuild, 'resolve_objects', lambda *a, **kw: dict(linked=True, exit=7))
    elif failure == 'proof':
        monkeypatch.setattr(finish, 'linked_proofs', lambda *a: [dict(code_exact_in_executable=False)])
    elif failure == 'stale':
        base['revision'] = 'advanced'
        config = json.loads((root / 'finish.json').read_text());config['auto_rebase'] = False
        (root / 'finish.json').write_text(json.dumps(config))
    elif failure == 'changed':
        def prove(*args):
            (root / 'test.cpp').write_text('concurrent edit')
            return [dict(code_exact_in_executable=True)]
        monkeypatch.setattr(finish, 'linked_proofs', prove)
    else:
        spec['layers'] = [dict(name='broken')]
        path = root / 'rebuild/2008-06/out/RbxgsApp/layer-broken';path.mkdir()
        (path / 'errors.json').write_text('{"file.cpp":"error"}')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        finish.run(root / 'finish.json', log=lambda _: None)
    assert not packets
    assert json.loads((root / 'finished/state.json').read_text())['state'] == 'failed'


def test_server_checkout_rejected_before_build(batch):
    root, *_ = batch
    (root / 'work').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'work/server.db').touch()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='private contributor'):
        finish.run(root / 'finish.json')


def test_packet_cannot_remove_accepted_path():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='removes accepted'):
        finish.source_packet(dict(revision='base', overlay={'App/accepted.cpp': [['x', 'y']]}), {},
                             dict(owned_addrs=['00400000']), {}, ['00400000'], 'model', 'evidence', {'00400000'})


def test_packet_uses_only_known_new_witnesses():
    base = dict(revision='base', overlay={})
    report = dict(owned_addrs=['00400000', '00400001'])
    packet = finish.source_packet(base, {}, report, {}, ['00400000', '00400001'],
                                  'model', 'evidence', {'00400000'})
    assert packet['targets'] == ['00400000']
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='No new owned targets'):
        finish.source_packet(base, {}, report, {}, ['00400001'], 'model', 'evidence', {'00400000'})


def test_nonconflicting_rebase_retains_both_changes_and_is_idempotent():
    before = dict(generator='same', overlay={'App/A.cpp': [['base', 'accepted']]})
    current = dict(generator='same', overlay={'App/A.cpp': [['base', 'accepted'], ['parameter', 'default10']]})
    ours = {'App/A.cpp': [['base', 'accepted'], ['tail', 'tail plus class name']]}
    rebased, paths = finish.rebase_candidate(before, current, ours)
    assert paths == ['App/A.cpp']
    assert rebased['App/A.cpp'] == current['overlay']['App/A.cpp'] + [['tail', 'tail plus class name']]

        patches={'App/include/Clothing.h': [['', 'namespace RBX { class Clothing {}; }']]})

    data = packet()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='invented'):
        integration.validate_patches(data['patches'])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='invented'):
        integration.validate_patches({'App/A.h': [['', 'class __declspec(novtable) Invented {};']]})
    result = promotion.receive(host, 'alice', data)

    assert host.store.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_jobs').fetchone()[0] == 0

    data['declarations'][0].update(name='RBX::ContactManager', size=20,

    identifier=promotion.receive(host,'alice',packet())['id']
    job_id=promotion.queue(host,identifier,identifier)['id']
    db=host.store.db
    db.execute("UPDATE integration_jobs SET phase='resuming' WHERE id=?",(job_id,))
    db.execute('INSERT INTO integration_jobs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
        ('ordinary','[]','ordinary-digest','alice','gpt-6.1-sol','RBX::Other','baseline',
         json.dumps({'App/Other.cpp':[['a','b']]}),'ordinary evidence','queued','resuming',10**12,10**12,'{}'))

    job=real.take()
    assert job['id']==job_id and 'members' not in job
    assert real.finish(job,dict(accepted=False,reason='probe failed'))
    assert db.execute('SELECT state FROM integration_type_proposals WHERE id=?',(identifier,)).fetchone()[0]=='rejected'
    assert promotion.queue(host,identifier,identifier)['retry']

def test_overlay_only_source_compiles_caches_and_detects_new_original(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    tree, overlay, output = tmp_path/'tree', tmp_path/'overlay', tmp_path/'out'
    tree.mkdir(); overlay.mkdir()
    original = tree/'Promoted.cpp'
    (overlay/'Promoted.cpp').write_text('int promoted(){return 1;}')
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'toolchain', lambda _: {})
    calls = []
    def run(tc, tool, args, cwd):
        calls.append(args)
        (cwd/'Promoted.obj').write_bytes(b'object')
        return 0, ''
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'run', run)
    def build():
        return rebuild.compile_direct('2008-06', [original], output, [], '', overlay=(tree,overlay))
    assert build()[str(original)][0]
    assert build()[str(original)] == (True, 'content cache hit')
    original.write_text('different authentic source now exists')
    build()
    assert len(calls) == 2


def test_direct_compile_overlaps_independent_sources_and_keeps_result_order(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    sources = [tmp_path / (name + '.cpp') for name in ('first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth')]
    for source in sources:
        source.write_text('void f();')
    header = tmp_path / 'shared.h'
    header.write_text('')
    barrier = threading.Barrier(4)
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'toolchain', lambda _: {})

    def run(tc, tool, args, cwd):
        barrier.wait(timeout=5)

def targets(monkeypatch, first=b'abcd', second=b'WXYZ', second_pointer=0x500090):

import json
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest

from roc import match, rebuild
from test_coff_data_index import object_bytes


@pytest.fixture
def native_target(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    image = bytearray(256)
    image[:6] = b'\xb8' + struct.pack('<I', 0x500080) + b'\xc3'
    image[0x80:0x88] = b'abcdefgh'
    functions = {'00500000': {'size': 6, 'relocs': [1]}}
    relocations = set()
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_image', lambda client: (0x500000, bytes(image)))
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_functions', lambda client: functions)
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_base_relocs', lambda client: relocations)
    obj, cache = tmp_path / 'native.obj', tmp_path / 'cache.json'
    obj.write_bytes(object_bytes())
    return image, functions, relocations, obj, cache


def test_same_proof_reused_without_rematching(native_target, monkeypatch):
    _, _, _, obj, cache = native_target
    context = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    expected = [('_f', 6, ['00500000'])]
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context) == (expected, False)
    def unexpected(*args):
        raise AssertionError('Unchanged proof should be reused')
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'pair_object', unexpected)
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context) == (expected, True)


def test_object_data_change_rejects_previously_exact_function(native_target):
    _, _, _, obj, cache = native_target
    context = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context)[0][0][2] == ['00500000']
    obj.write_bytes(object_bytes().replace(b'abcdefgh', b'ABCDEFGH'))
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context) == ([('_f', 6, [])], False)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('changed', ['image', 'bounds', 'relocs', 'implementation'])
def test_target_and_loaded_matcher_changes_invalidate(native_target, monkeypatch, changed):
    image, functions, relocations, obj, cache = native_target
    before = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, before)
    if changed == 'image':
        image[0x80] = ord('X')
    elif changed == 'bounds':
        functions['00500000']['size'] = 5
    elif changed == 'relocs':
        relocations.add(0x500080)
    else:
        original = match.exact_match
        def replacement(*args):
            return original(*args)
        replacement.__module__ = match.__name__
        monkeypatch.setattr(match, 'exact_match', replacement)
    after = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    assert after != before
    rows, hit = rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, after)
    assert not hit
    assert rows == rebuild.pair_object('test', obj.read_bytes())
    if changed in ('image', 'bounds'):
        assert rows[0][2] == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize('corrupt', ['truncated', 'checksum', 'shape'])
def test_damaged_cache_rechecked(native_target, corrupt):
    _, _, _, obj, cache = native_target
    context = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    expected, _ = rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context)
    saved = json.loads(cache.read_text())
    if corrupt == 'truncated':
        cache.write_text('{')
    else:
        saved['rows'] = [['_f', 6, ['00509999']]] if corrupt == 'checksum' else [1]
        if corrupt == 'shape':
            from roc.integration import digest
            saved['digest'] = digest(saved['rows'])
        cache.write_text(json.dumps(saved))
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context) == (expected, False)


def test_cached_twins_stay_ambiguous(native_target):
    image, functions, _, obj, cache = native_target
    image[16:22] = image[:6]
    functions['00500010'] = dict(functions['00500000'])
    context = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    expected = [('_f', 6, ['00500000', '00500010'])]
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context) == (expected, False)
    assert rebuild._ownership_rows('test', obj, cache, context) == (expected, True)


def test_loaded_code_identity_stable_across_process_hash_seeds():
    program = '''
import json
from roc import rebuild
def proof(value):
    return value in {'alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'}
print(json.dumps(rebuild._ownership_code(proof.__code__)))
'''
    import os
    outputs = [subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, '-c', program],
                                      env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONHASHSEED=seed))
               for seed in ('1', '2')]
    assert outputs[0] == outputs[1]


def test_context_stable_after_matcher_execution(native_target):
    _, _, _, obj, _ = native_target
    before = rebuild._ownership_context('test')
    rebuild.pair_object('test', obj.read_bytes())
    assert rebuild._ownership_context('test') == before

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from roc import rebuild_package


def test_curated_package_preserves_native_source_and_required_build_inputs(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    root = tmp_path / 'roc'
    source = root / 'rebuild/2008-06'
    for relative, data in {
        'modules/a.json': b'{}', 'glue/test.cpp': b'int glue;',
        'tests/test.cpp': b'int main() {}', 'out/engine/linked/linked.lib': b'0123456789abcdef',
        'manifests/functions.json': b'[]', 'check.py': b'print(1)',
        'out/log.txt': b'build complete', 'patches/rbxgs-client.json':
            json.dumps({'App/test.cpp': [['old', 'new']], 'App/added.h': [['', 'added']]}).encode(),
        'out/native-integration-token': b'PRIVATE',
    }.items():
        path = source / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)
    native = root / 'tools/rbxgs/Client/App/test.cpp'
    native.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    native.write_text('old')
    destination = root / 'local/findings/2008-06'
    manifest = rebuild_package.export(root, destination)
    assert (destination / 'config/a.json').read_text() == '{}'
    assert (destination / 'src/glue/test.cpp').is_file()
    assert (destination / 'verification/manifests/functions.json').is_file()
    assert (destination / 'src/rbxgs/Client/App/test.cpp').read_text() == 'new'
    assert (destination / 'src/rbxgs/Client/App/added.h').read_text() == 'added'
    assert native.read_text() == 'old'
    assert not (destination / 'work/build/native-integration-token').exists()
    assert not (destination / 'work/build/engine/linked/linked.lib').exists()
    assert not any(name.startswith('work/') or name.endswith(('.obj', '.lib', '.log')) for name in manifest['files'])
    for relative, digest in manifest['files'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((destination / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
    # Re-export never deletes a user's later test output.
    output = destination / 'work/build/after-export.txt'
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    output.write_text('keep')
    rebuild_package.export(root, destination)
    assert output.read_text() == 'keep'

import struct
import hashlib
import json
import os

from roc import match, rebuild


def test_explicitly_dropped_comdat_is_not_counted_as_reproduced_code():
    bodies = [b'\x33\xc0\xc3', b'\xb8\x01\x00\x00\x00\xc3', b'constant\0']
    symbols = bytearray()
    for section, name in enumerate([b'_keep', b'_discard', b'_literal'], 1):
        symbols += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'.text' if section < 3 else b'.rdata', 0, section, 0, 3, 1)
        aux = bytearray(18)
        struct.pack_into('<B', aux, 14, 2)  # IMAGE_COMDAT_SELECT_ANY
        symbols += aux
        symbols += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', name, 0, section, 0x20 if section < 3 else 0, 2, 0)
    offset = 20 + 3 * 40
    sections = bytearray()
    for index, body in enumerate(bodies):
        sections += struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI', b'.text' if index < 2 else b'.rdata',
                                0, 0, len(body), offset, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                                0x60001020 if index < 2 else 0x40001040)
        offset += len(body)
    obj = struct.pack('<HHIIIHH', 0x14c, 3, 0, offset, 9, 0, 0)
    obj += sections + b''.join(bodies) + symbols + struct.pack('<I', 4)

    stripped = rebuild.strip_symbols(obj, drop={'_discard'})
    assert {name for name, _, _ in match.coff_functions(stripped)} == {'_keep'}
    assert rebuild.coff_externals(stripped) == {'_keep': True, '_literal': True, '_discard': False}

    # Unrequested template code must resolve to native code or an explicitly retained helper.
    stripped = rebuild.strip_symbols(obj, keep={'_keep'})
    assert {name for name, _, _ in match.coff_functions(stripped)} == {'_keep'}
    assert rebuild.coff_externals(stripped) == {'_keep': True, '_literal': True, '_discard': False}

    (out / 'placed.json').write_text(json.dumps({hashlib.sha256(b'object').hexdigest(): ['old']}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'ROOT', tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'workspace', lambda client: tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, '_image', lambda client: (0, b''))
    monkeypatch.setattr(match, 'coff_functions', lambda data: [])

    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, 'pair', lambda *args: calls.append(args) or [])

def test_partial_object_keeps_only_selected_exports_and_preserves_other_directives():
    directives = (b' /DEFAULTLIB:MSVCRT /EXPORT:_keep /EXPORT:"public_name=_keep",DATA'
                  b' /EXPORT:_discard /EXPORT:"other=_discard",NONAME /INCLUDE:_legit ')
    raw = b'\xc3' + directives
    symbol_offset = 20 + 2 * 40 + len(raw)
    obj = struct.pack('<HHIIIHH', 0x14c, 2, 0, symbol_offset, 1, 0, 0)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI', b'.text', 0, 0, 1, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x60000020)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI', b'.drectve', 0, 0, len(directives), 101, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00100A00)

    assert b'_discard' not in result

def test_coff_subset_preserves_callbacks_weak_fallbacks_and_unwind_associations():
    bodies = [b'\xe8\0\0\0\0\xc3', b'\xc3', b'\xb8\0\0\0\0\xc3',
              b'\0' * 4, b'\xc3', b'unwind', struct.pack('<II', 4, 1),
              b' /DEFAULTLIB:MSVCRT /EXPORT:_unused ']
    section_names = [b'.text', b'.text', b'.text', b'.rdata', b'.text', b'.xdata', b'.sxdata', b'.drectve']
    relocations = {0: [(1, 7)], 2: [(1, 3)], 3: [(0, 4)]}
    definitions = [('_owner', 1, 0x20), ('_unused', 2, 0x20), ('_helper', 3, 0x20),
                   ('_vtable', 4, 0), ('_cb', 5, 0x20)]
    symbols = bytearray()
    for name, section, typ in definitions:
        symbols += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', name.encode(), 0, section, typ, 2, 0)
    symbols += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'.xdata', 0, 6, 0, 3, 1)
    aux = bytearray(18)
    struct.pack_into('<HB', aux, 12, 1, 5)
    symbols += aux
    symbols += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_alias', 0, 0, 0, 105, 1)
    symbols += struct.pack('<II10x', 2, 3)
    obj = bytearray(20 + 40 * len(bodies))
    for index, (name, body) in enumerate(zip(section_names, bodies)):
        raw_at = len(obj)
        obj += body
        refs = relocations.get(index, [])
        ref_at = len(obj) if refs else 0
        for offset, symbol in refs:
            obj += struct.pack('<IIH', offset, symbol, 6)
        struct.pack_into('<8sIIIIIIHHI', obj, 20 + 40 * index, name, 0, 0,
                         len(body), raw_at, ref_at, 0, len(refs), 0, 0x60000020)
    struct.pack_into('<HHIIIHH', obj, 0, 0x14c, len(bodies), 0, len(obj), 9, 0, 0)
    obj += symbols + struct.pack('<I', 4)
    subset, names = rebuild._coff_subset(bytes(obj), {'_owner'})
    assert names == {'_owner', '_helper', '_vtable', '_cb'}
    assert {name for name, _, _ in match.coff_functions(subset)} == {'_owner', '_helper', '_cb'}
    assert '_unused' not in rebuild.coff_externals(subset)
    _, section_count, _, symbol_at, count, _, _ = struct.unpack_from('<HHIIIHH', subset)
    assert section_count == 7 and count == 8
    sections = [struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIIIHHI', subset, 20 + 40 * i) for i in range(section_count)]
    sxdata = next(section for section in sections if section[0].startswith(b'.sxdata'))
    assert subset[sxdata[4]:sxdata[4] + sxdata[3]] == struct.pack('<I', 3)
    # Associative unwind section now follows owner section 1; weak fallback follows helper's new symbol index.
    assert struct.unpack_from('<HB', subset, symbol_at + 4 * 18 + 18 + 12) == (1, 5)
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I', subset, symbol_at + 6 * 18 + 18)[0] == 1

    external, names = rebuild._coff_subset(bytes(obj), {'_owner'}, external={'_helper'})
    assert names == {'_owner'}
    assert {name for name, _, _ in match.coff_functions(external)} == {'_owner'}
    assert rebuild.coff_externals(external) == {'_owner': True, '_helper': False}
    alias, _ = rebuild._coff_subset(bytes(obj), {'_alias'})
    assert {name for name, _, _ in match.coff_functions(alias)} == {'_helper', '_cb'}


def test_coff_subset_preserves_zero_initialized_storage_without_file_payload():
    obj = struct.pack('<HHIIIHH', 0x14c, 1, 0, 60, 1, 0, 0)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI', b'.bss', 0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xC0300080)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_global', 0, 1, 0, 2, 0) + struct.pack('<I', 4)
    result, names = rebuild._coff_subset(obj, {'_global'})
    assert names == {'_global'}
    section = struct.unpack_from('<8sIIIIIIHHI', result, 20)
    assert section[3:5] == (8, 0)
    assert rebuild.coff_externals(result) == {'_global': True}


def test_coff_subset_omits_safeseh_table_when_no_handlers_survive():
    # Both a compiler's empty table and a table pruned to zero entries must go.
    # VS2008 reports LNK1236 (or LNK1000 in archive lookup) if either remains.
    for payload in (b'', struct.pack('<I', 1)):
        obj = bytearray(100)
        struct.pack_into('<HHIIIHH', obj, 0, 0x14c, 2, 0, 101 + len(payload), 2, 0, 0)
        struct.pack_into('<8sIIIIIIHHI', obj, 20, b'.text', 0, 0, 1, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x60000020)
        struct.pack_into('<8sIIIIIIHHI', obj, 60, b'.sxdata', 0, 0, len(payload), 101, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x300200)
        obj += b'\xc3' + payload
        obj += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_owner', 0, 1, 0x20, 2, 0)
        obj += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_unused', 0, 0, 0x20, 2, 0) + struct.pack('<I', 4)
        result, _ = rebuild._coff_subset(bytes(obj), {'_owner'})
        assert struct.unpack_from('<H', result, 2)[0] == 1
        assert match.coff_functions(result) == [('_owner', b'\xc3', [])]


def test_coff_subset_resolves_forward_symbol_entry_to_its_later_definition():
    obj = struct.pack('<HHIIIHH', 0x14c, 2, 0, 117, 3, 0, 0)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI', b'.text', 0, 0, 6, 100, 107, 0, 1, 0, 0x60000020)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIIIIIIHHI', b'.text', 0, 0, 1, 106, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x60000020)
    obj += b'\xe8\0\0\0\0\xc3\xc3' + struct.pack('<IIH', 1, 1, 0x14)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_owner', 0, 1, 0x20, 2, 0)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_later', 0, 0, 0x20, 2, 0)
    obj += struct.pack('<8sIhHBB', b'_later', 0, 2, 0x20, 2, 0) + struct.pack('<I', 4)
    result, _ = rebuild._coff_subset(obj, {'_owner'})
    assert {name for name, _, _ in match.coff_functions(result)} == {'_owner', '_later'}
    assert rebuild.coff_externals(result) == {'_owner': True, '_later': True}

import struct

import pytest

from roc import rebuild


def pe_image(machine=0x14c, marker=b"first"):
    data = bytearray(256)
    data[:2] = b"MZ"
    struct.pack_into("<I", data, 0x3c, 128)
    data[128:132] = b"PE\0\0"
    struct.pack_into("<H", data, 132, machine)
    data[160:160 + len(marker)] = marker
    return data


def test_support_import_library_is_keyed_by_dll_contents(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, "workspace", lambda client: tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, "dll_exports", lambda path: ["SDL_Init"])
    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, "toolchain", lambda: {})
    calls = []

    def run(tc, tool, args, directory):
        calls.append(args)
        output = next(arg[5:] for arg in args if arg.startswith("/OUT:"))
        (directory / output).write_bytes(b"import library")
        return 0, ""

    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, "run", run)
    dll = tmp_path / "SDL.dll"
    dll.write_bytes(pe_image())
    first = rebuild.dll_import_lib("2008-06", dll.name, source=dll)
    assert first == rebuild.dll_import_lib("2008-06", dll.name, source=dll)
    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert "SDL_Init" in first.with_suffix(".def").read_text()
    dll.write_bytes(pe_image(marker=b"other"))
    assert rebuild.dll_import_lib("2008-06", dll.name, source=dll) != first
    assert len(calls) == 2

    monkeypatch.setattr(rebuild, "workspace", lambda client: tmp_path)
    dll = tmp_path / "SDL.dll"
    dll.write_bytes(pe_image(machine=0x8664))

def test_fanout_prefetch_keeps_serial_matching_and_journaling(monkeypatch):
    main = threading.get_ident()
    lock = threading.Lock()
    active = peak = 0
    seen = []

    def compile_text(client, source):
        nonlocal active, peak
        with lock:
            active += 1
            peak = max(peak, active)
        time.sleep(.02)
        with lock:
            active -= 1
        return source.encode()

    class Target:
        def match_obj(self, obj, source):
            assert threading.get_ident() == main and obj == source.encode()
            seen.append(source)
            return {}

    class Campaign:
        api = SimpleNamespace(call=lambda *args, **kwargs: [])

        def previous(self, stage):
            return []

        def record(self, stage, row):
            assert threading.get_ident() == main

    monkeypatch.setattr(research.match, "compile_text", compile_text)
    monkeypatch.setattr(research, "unresolved", lambda client, scores: Target())
    research.fanout(Campaign(), "test", [(str(i), i) for i in range(9)], jobs=3, log=lambda line: None)
    assert sorted(seen) == [str(i) for i in range(9)]
    assert 2 <= peak <= 3

    release = threading.Event()
    compiled, logs, receipts = [], [], []

    def compile_text(client, source):

        if source == "slow":
            assert release.wait(3), "Fast win must stream before slow compile finishes"
        return source.encode()

    class Target:
        def match_obj(self, obj, source):
            return {"00401000" if source == "fast" else "00401010": (0, "f")}

def test_research_lock_blocks_other_process_and_recovers_after_exit(tmp_path):
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import pytest
    from pathlib import Path
    path = tmp_path / "job.lock"
    code = "from pathlib import Path; from roc import research; import sys; " \
           "lock=research.job_lock(Path(sys.argv[1])); lock.__enter__(); print('ready', flush=True); sys.stdin.read()"
    process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", "-c", code, str(path)],
                               cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                               stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    try:
        assert process.stdout.readline().strip() == "ready"
        with pytest.raises(research.ResearchJobBusy):
            with research.job_lock(path):
                raise AssertionError("Duplicate lock acquired")
    finally:
        process.communicate(timeout=10)
    with research.job_lock(path):
        pass
